THESE PEOPLE DESERVE MONEY FOR THEIR CREATION  Ok imma talk about it a bit more So the story: 10/10 It is basically the main focus of the game, and god damn it did they do it right. It expands on Portal's story in an unbelievably natural way.  SPOILERS AHEAD [spoiler] Portal stories Mel is about Mel, a test subject from 1952, who was in extended relaxation all the way until right before the events of Portal 2. Virgil, a great substitude for Wheatly guides her through the ruins of the facility, wanting to escape with her. At first, he tries to cover the truth about the time passed, as to not give Mel a heart attack. After escaping the salt mines of old aperture, Virgil makes a testing track with the purpouse to get her out of there, but A.E.G.I.S., this game's equivalent of GLaDOS, who is a robot designed to keep everyone safe, mistakes Virgil and Mel to be the ones who flooded the facility with neurotoxin, and to get rid of them, floods it with deadly goo for a change, to stop the horrors of Aperture. Mel and Virgil are forced to escape to an overgrown testing track, as to hide themselves from A.E.G.I.S.'s lifeform scanners. They then shut A.E.G.I.S. down, only to find out that he was also detecting GLaDOS as a target, and wanted to drown her in goo, thus kicking off the events of Portal 2 as Mel escapes.[/spoiler]  Anyway moving on to gameplay: 8/10 This mod is the Portal 1 of Portral 2's mechanics (that meaning expanding on them and utilizing them to their fullest potential). Specificaly, this mod likes Funnels a lot. No, I'm serious, I think there's one in like every chamber from chapter 3 on. Anyway, the puzzles in this game can get reaal tough. I had to watch a walkthrough in Chapter 2 already, and there were other times where I really wanted to, but persisted and wasted a couple of minutes of my life Scratching my head. And I didn't even play advanced mode. Yes you heard that right, based on Portal 1's advanced chambers 13 - 18, these guys made the ENTIRE CAMPAIGN ADVANCED. So this mod is a real treat to Portal veterans. But not so much for casual gamers. There were so many times I just looked around for minutes trying to find something that would help me progress, which takes off one number of the rating, as for the second one, the boss is kinda lame tbh. It's quite slow and doesn't even use portals that much. But still, very solid gameplay.  Overall, GET THIS MOD PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD. Downloading and sharing with your portal friends is the absolute least you can do. Don't get me wrong, Portal 2 is still better. But like, that's a 10/10 game, and this is a 9/10 one. The difference is, that Portal 2 is for 8€, and this is FREE (well, considering you have portal 2 of course). But they both provide comparable levels of quality.  And for my final trick, I will compare this to Aperture tag. The difference is in the loyality to the base game. This mod stays loyal to Portal mechanics, themes, story, and characters. In aperture tag, the only thing staying the same is the set. You are in aperture laboratories. But everything else is doing its own thing. With wildly different mechanics, a theme and character inspired by portal 1, rather than the sequel. In terms of value to price ratio, Portal stories: Mel is of the same value as aperture tag. BUT IT'S FREE And this is why I want to donate to the devs. Because they deserve it.

Niveau difficulté c'est assez bien dosé, les combats sont simples et tactique mais une erreure peut rapidement retourner l'issue. L'histoire/le scénario est assez dirigiste, on n'a pas trop le choix sur la direction à prendre actuellement. Des arbres de talent et de compétences assez bien fait et diversifié. Idem pour l'inventaire, fidèle au RPG.  Je conseille ce jeu.

Swim back to the 90s were cassette tape was a thing, vest top was in fashion and everyone for some reason had their wallets sticking out, so you know what that means, thievery and scamming people. All of that, in order save up enough money to help your mother pay her debt from her mafia ex-boyfriend. Yay, you could probably tell I don't know much about the 90s, but I wish I born later around that time or even the 80s as this game is just screaming style down to the colourful characters and [b]Hip and Rad [/b] aesthetic with the patterns and the environment design.   Ali, (the character we're playing as) is such as cool protagonist with an imaginary skating ghost buddy, she just wanted to help do the impossible to pay up the impossible bills even if it lands her in prison. I liked was got some insight into her terminal struggles in doing what she's doing and that's spying on what people wanted and scamming from as well as stealing things from people. The gameplay of stealing money wasn't too hard, just stop at the right time for the censor to take the money without being noticed and the game gives you enough chances to do that without too much punishment.   Some of the issues I had with this game were the reused character models and I would have liked to montage of [spoiler]Ali returning the money [/spoiler], secondly, there are a few audio and animation character glitches.   Other than that, do consider playing this game to relive the 90s, plus now there are extra goodies like arcade mode from the Anniversary version which I haven't played, so you'll be playing more content than I did, what a treat. Watch the music trailer if you need any more convincing to play this game and maybe you can my record of stealing $144501.4, enjoy.

Интересный спин-офф ко второй части LIS, показывающее нам, скорее всего одного из главных персонажей - Криса. У него есть одна интересная особенность - он владеет телекинезом. Практически, как Кэрри Стивена Кинга)))  Крис вместе с отцом живут в частном доме, в каком-нибудь из штатов. Но для пускай это будет Канада. Люблю Канаду)) Живут они, в принципе хорошо, но возникает два вопроса в ходе смотра - где мать Криса и почему отец пьёт? Ответ на эти два вопроса кроется в записках, которые раскиданы по дому, а также в интерьере. Из записок становится понятно, что маму Криса убили, а отец после провалившегося и закрывшегося дела стал злоупотреблять крепким алкоголем и сыну уделять меньше внимания, тем самым не исполняя свои родительские обязанности!  А далее в личных отношениях между сыном и отцом, уже ближе к концу кроется вечная тема противостояния отцов и детей, как написано у великого Тургенева. Сын ещё в силу возраста не понимает всю глубину переживаний и моральную травму, которую отец пытается залатать алкоголем, а отец не понимает, что несмотря на то, что в него есть сын, ему не хватает не только материнской, но и отцовской любви. А также признания. Ребёнок из-за этого страдает и это видно все, возможно даже отцу, хоть он и пытается делать все, чтобы было лучше, чем раньше.  В конечном итоге, конфликт достигает такого апогея, что сын убегает, но тут с ним могло случится несчастье…но оно не случилось. Вера в лучшее спасла его, а после этого события он поверил в лучшее, а заодно в человечность других, ведь он знает, что где бы он не находился, у него всегда будут товарищи, которые его поддержат и помогут. Ой, как тонко и душевно! И пусть это лишь маленький отрывок ко второй части, при том, что я не играл в первую и уж тем более не в Истинные Краски - я уверен, что когда-нибудь у меня хватит времени на то, чтобы потом опробовать их все :) Ну а пока наслаждаемся и размышляем над тем, что есть) мне понравилось! Рекомендую к скачиванию, ведь к тому же она бесплатная, а тут сам Бог велел)))) 10/10

一个6 GB大小的游戏真的不要有太大的期望，这个游戏可以说是个半成品。先说优点，这个游戏的换身体的机制放在这种动作游戏上还是很有意思的，解锁不同的身体有不同的血量耐力技能什么的，而且还有类似只狼的复活机制的那种，第一次被打死后能回到身体里满血复活，然后还可以再回到上一次被彻底打死的身体里一次，算是可以满血复活两次。  说完优点剩下的全都是缺点，首先游戏的教程就不是很详细，玩了半天不知道决心是啥，怎么用武器技能。如果是对完全没有接触过魂类游戏的玩家来说基本上进去就是只有挨打的份。  道具说明写的也很迷惑，很多东西都不知道是用来干嘛的，根本就不知道那么多道具有啥用。而且游戏里回血的道具少得可怜，还需要玩家自己去地图里面收集。摸半天两个蘑菇回的量连血条的1/3都不到，魂游戏难归难你别故意恶心玩家。死亡惩罚就是直接扣光所有的钱，也捡不回来直接消失。基本上小怪砍你三刀你就死了。清图是不可能的了，那么多小怪打起来比boss都难，我基本上全都是直接冲过去的。要攒个4000块去升级技能那还是算了吧，贵的要死还没啥用。而且这个游戏好像是没有快速移动功能的，也没有地图，我跑图打怪一路到那个冰封教堂打第一殉教者那个地方，想回去换个武器，我还得一路走回去，死了钱还掉光，根本攒不起来。  作为一个魂玩家感觉boss难度还算可以，前期那些boss的血量不算高慢慢一刀一刀磨死不算太难。但是boss的攻击动作单一，而且看起来又慢又傻，一个boss基本上就三四种攻击动作。而且我发现好像这些boss都没有一个普通攻击类型的动作，全部都是一套一套的连招，合理运用闪避和硬化还是能完美化解连招的。打下来感觉都差不了太多boss战很无聊。唯一一个有意思的boss就是那个拿大剑的那个boss，打起来还有点魂游戏的样子，其他的boss打起来就很枯燥了。然后最让人无语的那个boss第一殉教者，他的一阶段基本上没啥，动作少得可怜，基本上打个两三次就摸清楚套路了，就等他放二连斩接竖劈然后上去打他一套，然后需要听声音判断他消失之后会到那里去。然后这个家伙二阶段tmd血量直接翻倍，速度快了很多而且还会后撤躲避玩家攻击。但是他的那个突刺真的就很让人无语。一般游戏碰到突刺攻击就是横着闪避比较好躲，这家伙我横着闪避了他直接人跟着我一起转，横向闪避根本躲不掉。 然后最气人的就是他那个突刺动作很慢，前摇后摇都很长，但是只要你蹭到他的剑你就会掉血，而且就算他攻击动作结束了你蹭到他的剑你照样会算被打到，唯一躲闪的方法就算往后疯狂滚拉开距离。我横着滚完他剑跟着我原地转的90°然后我蹭了一下他悬在空中的剑，我死了，就真的很无语。本来觉得这个游戏还是有的玩头的，结果被这个boss气得我立马来写差评。  玩家的攻击动作是比较慢的，对于最近刚打完只狼这种快节奏动作的我来说是很不适应的，玩起来感觉真的就是回合制游戏的感觉。买这个游戏之前我看评论说这个游戏的耐力太少了不够用，我还不信邪，然后我自己玩了之后发现这个耐力条真的就是只够你砍三四刀就空了。初始角色的耐力基本上就只够你砍死一个小怪（还不算上翻滚）。我以为这个游戏最重要的是耐力那耐力越长越好，我获得了那个耐力条巨长的那个哥们儿。他血条长度看起来跟初始角色差不多长，结果被最垃圾的小怪砍了两刀（真的就两刀）就死了，感觉他扣血比别的角色扣的还要多。  要不是看在打了个3折的份上买了这游戏，不然真的觉得不值。

A beat 'em up for adults done right.  Mother Russia Bleeds combines gameplay of classic games of the genre that many of us played in the 90s, while also giving it all a more mature and violent theme.  Thus: Yes, you do scroll to the right while stopping to beat up a bunch of enemies. Yes, the enemies aren't threatening, but rely on numbers and gimmicks to make up for it. Yes, you get a few simple combos to vary things up. Yes, you get a variation of enviroments along with arena hazards to complicate your fights. Yes, you can play with a friend at the same computer. And of course there's bossfights, some playing more like a puzzle, others just figuring out patterns.  While the base gameplay is pretty much the same as the classics that inspired, its mostly the ultra-violent theme that puts the game apart. You're playing a group of hobo streetfighters kidnapped by the government for drug testing, who are now out for violent revenge. The enemies you fight don't have health bars, but become bloodied and slower the more damage they take. Bodies don't blink out of existence but litter the ground. You can beat on downed enemies and it's as brutal as the pixel graphics allow. And you don't get healing items, but heal through dosing up on drugs that you extract from spasming enemy corpses mid-combat. Overally the violent theme isn't self-serving but is used to portray a distopic alternate reality soviet russia where the only justice that can be had is street justice and it works pretty well as far as I'm concerned.  The game does have issues too, story mode isn't particularly long, I've finished it in 4 hours on normal and I'm no fighting game expert. Arena mode is fairly bland and serve more like challenges to beat than anything else. Difficulty can catch inexperienced players off guard and stunlocking is huge if you get caught by surprise in a crowd of enemies, the dodge button is essential in tougher fights. Oh and as of writing this review online coop is not yet implemented, though the devs have stated they intend to add it over time.  All in all, it's a solid game, that's simple fun with enough challenge to satisfy the veteran player too. Though it doesn't bring any particularly new gameplay to the table, if you played a beat 'em up before, this one won't surprise. On the other hand you get beat a downed opponent to death with a fire extinguisher. Hard to say no to the simple joys in life.

[h1] Лучший из обоих миров и  единственный ли он человек!? [/h1] [h1] Сюжет: [/h1] повествование начинается в ранних воспоминаниях Саймона где-то в 2015 году в офисе Торонто, чуть позже переносится в подводный мир, где Саймон находит со временем коллегу Кэтрин. Потом действия переносят в 2104, когда человечество почти полностью было уничтожено в ходе падения кометы, исходя из рассказов Кэтрин Чон и экипаж из 58 человек мог спасти, но только через проект Ковчег. И тут у Саймона возникает вопрос, исходя из того, что на его пути попадаются лишь роботы, 3 из которых пытались его убить, единственный ли он человек. Вопрос с одной стороны решается позже по развитию истории. И неоднозначная причастность Кэтрин к происходящему на Тэт. Вообщем история развивается умеренно, не спешно, через рассказы с аудио-устройств. Ибо на кат-сцены у студии денег не было, но они смогли выкрутиться интересными диалогами с глубоким смыслом. Концовка игры до титров, мало кого оставит равнодушными. [h1] Геймплей: [/h1] о нём тут рассказывать особо нечего, всё что мы можем находить фотографии из прошлого и записки. Поднимает предметы без должной анимации. [h1] Графика: [/h1] визуальный ряд весьма бюджетный он тогда ещё отставал лет на 5, эффектов как токовых нет вроде взрывов или огня, освещение весьма добротное, сглаживания нормально работаю в отличии от других инди-хорроров. Местами тонкие текстуры: папки на Тэте проваливались сквозь стол. Детализация хорошая для игры с малым бюджетом: вдали, читаемые абсолютно все надписи, хоть и отключаешь искажение, а оно всё равно работает. Ещё и камера трясётся, когда герой от агрессоров огребает, выглядит реалистично, но потом надоедает. Но проверку временем, она визуально  не проходит. [h1] Левел-дизайн: [/h1] годный, но не впечетляющий. Элементы интерьера имеются, локации коридорные, местами запутанные. [h1] Саундтреки: [/h1] в напряжённые моменты хорошо вписаны и в драматичные тоже, заставляют прочувствовать переживания героев Линдвелл, Хилла,Брэндона, Саймона и Кэтрин, в особенности. [h1] Звук: [/h1] подводный звук выполнен хорошо, но его настройка, через один ползунок, как у Far Cry4 без разделений на диалоги, музыку, звуки ощущается местами хорошо. [b] Плюсами игры стали: + сюжетная линия с интересным повествование и харизматичной озвучкой Саймона, Кэтрин, Брэндона, Линдвелл, Хила, Йохансона и других; + визуальный ряд выполнен в целом не плохо, для скромной студии, нормальная детализация и освещение, подводные виды; + левел-дизайн и местами атмосфера замкнутости и беспомощности, дополненная локаничными саундтреками; + добрый ИИ у враждебных НИУ; Минусы: - тряска камеры, эффект при котором двоится изображение, когда герой ранен; - геймплей в целом и отсутствие анимации рук во время взаимодействия с объектами; - отсутствие разделения звука и цензурная официальная локализация в виде титров. [/b] [i] Итог: 8 из 10 отличная игра,  у таких игр повествование имеет очень важное значение значение. [/i] Порекомендую преданным фанатам Амнезии и любителям хорроров со скромным бюджетом, но интересным сюжетом.

Reviews are not really my thing. They seem trivial, arbitrary and pointless usually. That isn't what this is.  I used to have to work with absurdly large numbers. Still do. I could've told you the usefullness of Avegadro's Number (6.022 x 10^23) but, at the same time, I would struggle to tell you what that number was in words and i would've had no sense of it's scale and enormity in the slightest. Now I can tell you with ease that this; Six Hundred Two Quintillion and Two Hundred Quadrillion and that it is so massive that should you be counting to it by One Million every second It would still take about two years to count to. That is scale expressed magnificently.  This game teaches an understanding and appreciation of scale while imparting the names of large numbers and for those two reasons alone it is worth playing for at least a little while.

This should be the new standard for survival games. My favorite thing about this is that they have removed some of the tedious chores such as mass farming. Kelvin is a massive help, considering he can assist with all of those chores. ( just dont ask him to gather logs if you're building a tree house, or you wont have a tree for your house) The caves are amazing and are dark and eerie, then coming up out of a cave thru the ocean was such a cool experience.   Some of the poor reviews forget that this is an EARLY ACCESS game. There are currently only 3 challenging caves, but tons of empty caves with a bit of loot - I'm hoping those are early access place holders as they develop and add more (fingers crossed)  The building is unique and rewarding, allowing you to custom build if you don't want to throw down a basic blueprint. I love the immersion you get from actually placing down each log, and shaping it by cutting the wood yourself rather than selecting a wall, a windowed wall, foundation, etc.   Most early access games don't come nearly this complete, and for $30 this is a hell of a fun time. I cant wait to see what the future has in store for Sons of the Forest!

The 1994 XCom was one of my very 1st computer games that I bought and I loved the crap out of it. The freedom of strategy and the random maps which gave each mission a different feel. I remember the music of the game when playing late into the night with that heart beat like sound, which seem to immerse you into the game almost made you feel the terror of the soldiers you were controlling. Terror from the Deep did much of the same with an increase of weapons, armor and aliens. And Apocalypse had all kind of weapons, armors and research along with a good story about the aliens but was a bit cumbersome to move your squad around in turned based but worked well the real time option but then you used a ton of ammo.  And for years nothing of any real notability came about until the remake of XCOM Enemy Unknown and Enemy Within showed up. It capture many of those same aspects of the original game did but with 3D graphic and with those camera angles that brought you to the soldiers view of the battlefield, which once again gave that immersion feeling of almost being in the fight yourself.  I think I logged over 1800 hours playing that game. But there were some aspects of the 1st Xcom that I wish were present in the remake, like how you had to buy or make everything right down to the ammunition for your guns (no infinite items) and how nothing was made or researched instantly but instead you could add more personal and facilities to reduce the time it took.  Anyway as for XCOM 2……I thought the game was excellent in that it gives you that intensity level that every decision you make is critical to your success. It also answered that nagging question about what the hell the aliens were abducting people for in the first place. Now it has it clichés, like how windows would break before my guy even started running toward it or the crazy psychedelic light shown in final mission to name few. But overall I rank this game up there with some of best that I have played and I also see the potential that lie within the game to give us a wide verity different gaming angles with how many mods are already up and running.  We the players are in store for some really great gaming experiences (once all of the bugs get worked out, as with most games that have just been release.)

A standard 3rd Person Shooter with a handful of unique features to make it stand out on its own from others in the genre, but the real focal point is the story. This story is phenomenal, and will make you question quite a few things at the end. I heard the Multiplayer was pretty meh, but I never played that part, so I can't comment on it. Personally, I like the environment too. Something odd about saying how you like a lot of sand, but the way Dubai is set up makes it look kind of post apocalyptic to me. Giant buildings that were once really nice looking, with some you can even see how nice they once looked, but now are somewhat toppled over with sand and other debris all over the place. It is 100% worth playing through at least once for the story, and since there aren't any multiplayer achievements, you can also 100% the game if you wish. Its a bit of a short campaign. On Normal I think its took my about 9 hours to beat. I would recommend buying on sale since there isn't multiplayer anymore.

I tried to like this game I really did, but unfortunately it just pales in comparison to other games of the same formula. Its even more tragic that this enhanced version still managed not to get it right or even make it better the second time around. The whole experience feels like a long-winded drudge. Weapons don't feel strong or impactful and some of their sounds are lacking. Melee isn't all that great either especially after playing something like Verm 2, where it's far more superior and satisfying. The level up system is grindy and doesn't feel meaningful or significant. Some people swear by the flamethrower visuals as being some of the best looking, but in reality its bright as hell and more distracting than anything. Once again other games have done it better. The concept of slowly lumbering around in epic terminator armor sounded good on paper, but after awhile it just feels cumbersome and clunky. Adding to an already slow paced chore of a game.    The only saving grace is some of the graphics. A hodge-podge of random machinery, pipework, and dark gritty cathedral like architecture that make up the space hulks. Some areas open up into awe-inspiring vistas that make you want to pause and take it all in. However the biggest tragedy of all this, was that it could have been an amazing game particularly for fans of the 40k franchise. Literally all they had to do was throw in the gameplay of Vermintide 2 with the gunplay of a Titan mech, cover it with 40k space marines and bingo, profit. Instead it all feels like a fan made mod for a game that wasn't designed well to begin with.   And sadly I highly advise you pass this one up even on a sale. The advertisement and videos make it look awesome as if it was some sort of hidden gem that people overlooked, but don't be deceived. With the announcement of Darktide, I regret ever even purchasing this, let alone giving it a try. Ultimately a great idea marred by bad game design, poor sounds and terrible weapons.

Tough choice, on whether to recommend this or not. The game has a lot of problems: poor resolution; unskippable animations; one game-breaking bug (in English version), and broken ending cutscenes (there are two distinct endings based on your final action). There is an unofficial fix available on the Steam Community that fixes the last two technical errors but, still, they should have official fixes by now and are totally unacceptable. Besides those points, the game is fairly solid considering it had such a tiny team was developed as part of a university thesis. The translation is also very good and I only noticed errors in some of the interface and achievements; the dialogue is flawless. It's a very solid adventure that feels quite similar (and pays homage to) the comical Lucasarts adventure games.  Although Harvey was getting on my nerves by the end, Edna is one of the most of likeable protagonists I've seen in an adventure game in some time. She is adorably bonkers and reminds me of Laverne from Day of the Tentacle. But that being said, and although I look forward to trying the sequel, the quality of the game (game-breaking bugs included) and the $15 price tag do not match up. If you see it on sale, though, for a few dollars (and locate the unoffical fixes before you start) it's probably worth it.

The introduction of fire-arms is good.  Negatives: 1. I don't understand why the log sled isn't in this game, log sleds in the first game were so important but for some reason they aren't in this game. The way I got logs to my base was making a dam near my base and chopping a tree so the logs go into the river and then get stopped by the dam so I can use the logs. 2. Some of the caves are empty and honestly feels like a waste of time going up to a cave and finding like two duct tape. 3. The story feels very random and doesn't feel very good to finish. When I was playing through the game I was expecting some really emotional ending or a boss battle or something but no I don't want to spoil the story for those who haven't finished it yet but just know that I don't think the story makes much sense. 4. I feel like it's kind of dumb leaving such good items to find just sitting out in the wild. For example the modern axe is just sitting in some random campsite you don't even have to go into a cave or fight anyone  its just chilling there. I feel like there needs to be something for transportation such as a bicycle or something because right now it's a pain walking by foot.  Conclusion: This game is in early access so hopefully most of my negatives will be fixed in the future. There is also a lot of bugs but its an early access game so it's fine. I don't want to say much more because this is truly an experience you have to have for yourself. This is not a game about massive plot twists or cheap tricks, but rather about realizing time and time again that there were levels upon levels in the game world that you couldn't previously even conceive of.  Seriously one of the best games of 2016, if not the best. Play it.

기존 시스템을 새로 뜯어고치는 시도는 좋았다. 하지만 명불허전 CA라는 이름을 다시 한번 떠올리게 한다. 판 벌리는건 잘하는데 판만 컸지 실속은 없고 패치는 유저들이 하나하나 뜯어고친다. 문제점들을 모드 없이 개선하려면 또 몇개월이 걸릴까. 아직 여포랑 엄백호밖에 못했다. 그래도 엄백호 하나만 걸고 넘어가도 충분할거 같다.   도적세력을 완전히 뜯어 고친거는 좋았다. 캡인가 뭔가 이전작품에서 하던 시스템을 적용한거라는데. 처음에만 신선하고 나중가면 정말 불편한 시스템이다.  민병대나 황건적들을 진법을 못 쓰고 이번에 나온 도적들도 진법을 못 쓴다. 그나마 엄백호의 백호 궁수대는 장창진이 가능한데 이건 숲속에서만 가능하다. 심지어 이 백호 궁수대는 불화살을 못쏜다. 불화살을 쓰고 싶으면 1티어 기본 궁수를 써야한다. 그렇다면 위에 도적 전용 연구트리에서 궁수 연구를 하면 되지 않겠냐 하지만. 실질적으로 뽑을 수 있는 궁수는 익주궁병 2기 뿐이다. 나머지는 연노병 4기와 철갑연노병 4기가 끝이다. 기마궁수들을 뽑으려면 저쪽 땅끝까지 연구를 해야 그나마 몇기 뽑을 수 있다.  이처럼 병력의 종류가 한정되고 진법도 사용 할수 없다. 캡으로 풀리는 유닛들도 많이 줘봐야 2기. 아니면 1기 정도만 주니. 소수정예로 병력을 굴릴때는 좋지만 중반부에 병력을 더 뽑기 시작하면 기본 유닛들로만 전투하는게 재미가 없어진다. 황제가 되면 그나마 황제 전용 유닛이 풀려서 감시자나 용장한테 천군금만 줬다. 천통할때까지 천군금만 죽어라 썼다. 연구로 뚫린 흉노족 기병들은 여포한테 몰아주니깐 다 썼다. 6기인가 8기 정도가 끝이다. 천통을 하는 그 순간까지도 모든 선봉장들은 도적 기병만 썼다. 그나마 마등이나 조조 밑에서 굴렀던 항장들한테 고유 기병들이 붙어 있으면, 감사합니다. 하고 썼다. 장수의 성능은 보지도 않았다. 보유 부대에 상위티어 병종이 있냐 없냐가 중요했다.  정말 주말 내내 달려서 엄백호로 천통을 했지만 중반부터 너무 재미가 없었다. 분명 장연도 정강도 이 시스템으로 바뀌었을 텐데.  플레이해보지는 않았지만 분명 난이도 엄청나게 올랐을거라 생각한다. 하필 붙어도 하북에서 시작하는 애들이다. 흉노나 선비족 기병들을 뽑을 수야 있겠지만. 과연? 좌측에 여포랑 동탁이 있고 우측에는 원소랑 공손찬. 194년 시나리오에서 정강은 조조랑 유비, 유총 사이에서 시작하는데 더 답이 없을거라 생각한다.   그리고 패치내역에는 없던건데. 이제 플레이어들도 무기공방 만들어서 무기 생산할 수 있다. 고유장비들은 특정 지역을 먹어야지만 드랍이 되는건 여전하지만. 그래도 이것만이라도 해도 감지덕지...인줄 알았는데. 체감은 잘 되지 않는다.  클론무장들을 유니크화 시킬거 아니면 적당한 수준 같기도 한데. 만들기 시작하는 시기를 생각하면 좀 아쉬운 부분이다. 그나마 도적세력이라서 상업,산업 생각 안하고 도적질 수입에 올인하면 되서 여러개 만들 수 있었는데. 한나라 세력권은 선뜻 만들기 어려울 거 같다.

Игра с тяжелой судьбой и темным прошлым. Анонсированная многие годы назад и потерпевшая полный крах в лице Carribean, она наконец имеет в целом законченный вид и перемен в будущем претерпевать не намерена. Так что же в этом «законченном виде» может предложить игрокам, охочих до соленой морской романтики? А много чего! Тут вам сражения морские, сражения сухопутные, штурмы фортов, торговля залихватская! А теперь обо всех аспектах игры по порядку: 1. Сухопутные сражения остались в целом схожи с оригинальной Mount&Blade, разве что подконтрольные юниты претерпели изменения, ибо теперь бал правит огнестрел, поэтому рыцарей и лучников потеснили мушкетеры, хоть и не изгнали совсем. Из новшеств – теперь юниты можно расставлять перед сражением. Реализовано, правда, довольно коряво: бойцы перед сражением группируются игрой в отряды самостоятельно, построения менять и составлять нельзя, а сами иконки отрядов цепляются, видать, за неровности на карте (она – тоже новшество), так что хитроумные схемы устраивать получается редко. Чаще всего либо ждем на холме, либо устраиваем банзай-атаку. 2. Морские бои вышли аркадными и сравнивать их с «Корсарами» будет не очень уместно. Все на минималочках: повернулся нужной стороной к врагу – дал залп, развернулся. Боеприпасы – ядра, книппели, картечь. Из интересных находок – пожар – страшная вещь. Его тему разработчикам удалось раскрыть хорошо, как и абордаж. В остальном – всё скромненько. 3. Торговля. Можно продавать. Можно покупать. Можно строить здания, производящие продукцию. Которую можно продавать. Можно (грабить) организовывать конвои, остальное не нужно. 4. Квесты – подай, убей, принеси. Никаких хитросплетений, всё линейно. 5. Развлечения – блэкджек, скачки, девушки легкого поведения, драки в таверне (бить проститутку табуреткой незабываемо). Из претензий – старая графика (впрочем, разрабы постарались как могли), не самая лучшая (до кучи патчей ужасная) оптимизация и в целом скудный ассортимент всего – от моделей до квестов. В целом игра, конечно, звезд с неба не хватает. От нее так и веет малым бюджетом, а кое-где спущенными рукавами. Но я не могу назвать игру плохой. Скорее, она не получила должного развития, так что поначалу она способна увлечь и даже очаровать (прекрасная музыка этому немало способствует). На пару вечеров или недельку, после чего скорее приестся, едва раскроет все свои возможности. Впрочем, могут найтись и люди, вроде меня, не убоявшиеся подобной монотонности и захотевшие построить свою империю на Карибах…

- This game is great. It's well made for what it is and is very fun, though lacking somewhat in variety. It's only about an hour long even with going for secrets.  - The gameplay loop is simple: beat up enemies and rescue them, screw the turned enemies, destroy chastity orbs, collect hidden health upgrades, repeat. There are metroidvania aspects such as a hammer upgrade and a double jump that unlock new areas. The entire game world is connected without loading screens and in latter parts of the game you can fall between areas. - The creature models including the player character are very well made and well animated. The player character especially is given ample personality and is very cute. The terrain is also well modeled and textured with excellent use of ambient occlusion and lighting. I personally didn't experience any lag at all. (I played on the highest settings for reference) - The sex scenes are randomly selected from a handful of short loop animations often with props that are spawned in at need. There's mxm, mxf, and fxf, although each creature has a preference and won't giggity a creature not to its preference (including you). - There are a lot of small details that improve the game quite a bit such as the player's outfit being dynamic: starting with full health you have a small shirt and shorts, which you lose when you get hit; then you get a chastity outfit if you get hit by a chastity drone, which you also lose when getting hit. Healing has a slightly different animation depending on which direction you're facing, either playing directly towards the camera or directly away from the camera. Hitting bells sets a checkpoint as well as healing you. You can also up-air the bells with your spinny hammer and get dopamine. - Moving the right stick on a controller (my recommended control for this game) at any time zooms the camera in and allows some limited panning around your character. - My main peeves of the game include no post game content such as a scene viewer, its short length, limited replayability, only two creature types, and there are pillars at the end of the mines with dev textures.  8/10

[h1]Один в поле - воин![/h1] Данное HD переиздание является всё точно тем же старым добрым Serious Sam, но только с улучшенными тенями, шейдерами, текстурами, освещением, анимацией и еще многими меликими изменениями, дающими теплое чувтсво ностальгии, бережно перенесённое на рельсы HD качества. Сама игра была новым откровением в свое время, когда эпоха шутеров без сюжета канула в лету и стало появляться всё больше шутеров с упором на сюжет, таких как Deus Ex, Half-Life и прочих. Хорватские разработчики из Croteam решили наплевать на тренды и вернуть геймеров в 90-е, сделав основной упор на динамику, зрелищность и экшен. Также основной фишкой SS стали просто огромные толпы врагов, сыплющиеся на Сэма в бесконечном потоке на протяжении всей игры на не менее огромных территориях. Также стоит отметить одни из самых эпичным музыкальных композиций в истории, отлично вписывающиеся в геймплей. Сама игра и Сэм как персонаж стали культовой классикой от мира FPS, на годы вписав себя в умы геймеров по всему миру.

说道军事题材的射击游戏，不得不提到一个已故的大师——汤姆克兰西，他的小说不仅真实，而且还透露着对近未来小队级作战的设想，非常值得大家去看。  而挂着汤姆克兰西名头的幽灵行动系列，至今已经发展了5代共6部作品，从一开始的第一人称射击，到主机平台反响良好于是果断改进的第三人称射击，这款从2001年开始的游戏已经经过了16个年头，在当年一票现代和二战风格的FPS里面，带有近未来风格的幽灵行动可谓是独树一帜，不过脱胎于彩虹六号的指挥系统让这个游戏的难度猛增，适应FPS快节奏独行侠的玩家们极度不适，不过随着UBI的调整，背追式第三人称射击+快速指令下达方式和较高等级的AI，让这款游戏越来越适应现代的快节奏。  1：画面 UBI最会营造什么？毫无疑问是画面，哪怕是缩水后的画面也完全不虚任何3A，荒野的画质属于上乘之作，漫步在玻利维亚可以体验到当地民生和以假乱真的风景，如果你有一对泰坦，还可以开启更高级的画质，坐在家里体验真实的玻利维亚美轮美奂的风景（可惜的是雨后的天空之境没办法表现出来，估计是做出来大家就玩不动了）  2：队员 随着尖峰战士，未来战士之后，荒野回归了现代风格，取消了各种高大上的黑科技，不过系统也做了调整和简化（这种简化简直要命）基础小队操作只有开火，待命，移动和归队4个指令，没办法像尖峰战士那样单独命令每个队员组成包围圈，也没办法像未来战士那样发挥AI的主观能动性，不过毕竟这次的荒野和前两作不同，属于开放沙盒式而不是一本道式，也算是情有可原。另外，值得注意的是，联机游戏下才能体会到荒野的精髓，AI执行命令太过死板了。  3：剧情 就本质来说荒野依然是一个带有剧情的游戏，这次的剧情不是击杀恐怖分子或者压制军事政变，而是缉毒（毒品是有害的，大家要远离它，有没有让大家想起战地硬仗？）说实话这次的剧情一点都不刺激，4名精锐特种部队队员协助反ZF武装去一边抗击暴政，一边打击毒贩，这一点也不汤姆克兰西好吧！不过，看完全部剧情大家会有惊喜，这妥妥的还是克兰西风格啊！不过任务过于分散也是沙盒游戏的弱点，跑路时间占据总游戏时间的一半以上确实不是个令人愉快的体验过程。  4：系统 本次的荒野，依旧保留了前几作的枪匠设计，通俗点说就是武器自定义，这可以让4名玩家联机的时候分工合作，最大化的照顾到方方面面，比如，我想当突击手，那么精简化注重操控的微冲和中远距离交战特化设定的突击步枪就是不错的搭档，如果想当火力手，那么特别强化稳定，抑制后坐力的机枪就是不错的选择，每一种武器都可以通过多个零件的搭配获得相应的强化方向，通力协作完成任务简直让喜欢PVE类型的玩家们欣喜若狂。而且，还可以通过自定义人物来创造属于自己的幽灵战士，虽然脸依旧很丑……  5：不足 说了这么多好处，那么有没有不足呢？当然有，UBI没有BUG简直不科学，从早期大家一致诟病的不能选空投的载具，到完全不知道打哪全靠蒙的直升机主驾驶武器再到车辆开起来根本没有速度感飘的厉害为止，充满了设定上的不足（已经进行了改进），时不时发现驾驶员坐在直升机外面，或者完全就是跟着跑的BUG也是层出不穷。当然，最让人反感的就是3个联机划分，简直不可理喻完全不知道怎么匹配的，有的时候根本就是冲突完全无法联机，但是野人倒是分分钟进入，搞不懂啊，搞不懂。  总结：你要说荒野吼不吼哇，我会回答：吼哇！但是它地图虽大却方式单一，重复游玩的兴趣也不算很大，虽然出了2部DLC，但都不算特别出彩，PVP模式也是刚刚上线，还不知道情况如何，总之，这款游戏值得推荐，但是强烈建议打折的时候购入，最好你需要有3个基友一起玩。

[b]Inhalt[/b] Siedler im Kleinen, als Casual, ohne Krieg. Oder so :)  [b]Grafik[/b] Putzig und verspielt, man sieht's an den Bildern, die macht durchaus Spaß, auch die ganzen kleinen Animationen, erinnert mich ein kleines bisschen wie die frühen Sims im Comic-Stil. Leider sehen die Leute sich ziemlich ähnlich, da hätte ich mir mehr Abwechslung gewünscht. Aber das ist schon Jammern auf sehr hohem Niveau.  [b]Sound[/b] Es dibt einige Lieder, die sich immer wieder abwechslen, zum Teil wirklich sehr angenehm und beruhigend, zum Teil eher Fahrstuhlmusik. Ich hatte aber nie das Bedürfnis, den Sound bzw. die Hintergrundmusik abzuschalten.  Sonst die Töne sind durchaus angenehm. Und ich habe mich immer wieder gewundert, wie viele Vögel bei mir auf der Fensterbank sitzen - klingt sehr echt :)  [b]Spielprinzip[/b] Alles in allem sehr einfach und casuel. Ich hätte gern einen Zoom bzw. Entzoomen gehabt, aber das ist nicht ganz wichtig, unten in der Ecke gibt es ja eine Karte. Ansonsten kann man pro Ding nur eine Sache machen, d.h. man zieht einen Farmer zu einem Feld und der macht dort alles, was anliegt. Easy going :)  [b]Minispiele[/b] Es gibt einige Minispiele, z.B. muss man mit dem eigenen Schiff Piraten besiegen, das hat dann etwas von Tank Wars. Dann gibt es noch Häuser mit fest gelegten Räumen, die man verteilen muss, damit der ganze Grund belegt ist. Und am Ende soll es noch ein Spiel geben, da bin ich aber noch nicht.  [b]Spieldauer[/b] Ich habe etwa 12 Stunden und bin ziemlich weit. Man könnte sicherlich schneller sein, vor allem, wenn man's drauf anlegt oder Vorwissen hat.  [b]Fazit[/b] Ein schönes Spiel für zwischendurch. Ich kann es nur weiterempfehlen. Wer allerdings eher so Siedler/Anno/etc.-Pro ist, würde vielleicht ein bisschen enttäuscht sein.

This is an action rpg with many cool ideas and multiple endings that encourage you to replay the game from different view points. While there are 26 endings (one for each letter of the alphabet) only A-E are actual endings, with the rest of them mostly joke endings such as when you uninstall your OS or die in the prologue. Not every idea it has is a winner in its execution, but the general execution of the game along with the height of its best ideas raise the game up to be a memorable one.  Notably the game tries to channel the player non-interaction of Dark Souls in the guise of the corpses of where your fellow players died which you can use for minor temporary bonuses. But after 5-10 hours you can just ignore them. Yet this player non-interaction does eventually play out in a rather impressive way by the end.  The game starts out challenging, including the prologue itself to a certain degree, but mostly because there is no way to save until you complete the prologue. If you die, you even have to reach your corpse to collect all your equipment and items since your last save. Yet once you get the right equipment, death becomes neigh impossible through the use of auto-healing unless you want to crank up the difficulty.  I feel like I spent 10 hours more than I would had liked with this game as I tried to complete the side quests, farm for upgrades, and extract all the enjoyment I could from the game. While the side quests can sometimes be annoying to complete, they often have a nuget of a cool story bit with each of them. Regardless, whatever self-inflicted bad taste I had in my mouth was washed away by the final ending.  One thing to note about attempting side quests and farming early is that the game offers more and more quality of life options as the game progresses. It starts with teleporting between every save point, the ability to open locked chests, unlocking a ride-able animal at each save point, and finally a chip that lets you auto collect all those items in a decent radius that you had to walk up and push a button to collect. And if you hate being a completionist, well you'll eventually unlock a merchant who will flat out just sell you the game's achievements.  Sometimes complaining points to genuine problems with the game, other times when a game is so good, the few problems it has seem more glaring. With Nier, it is squarely in the latter. The game becomes more depressing with each play through and I enjoyed seeing it through to the very end. Notably I found the start of route C and the final ending E to be the standout moments of this that I will remember for quite some time.  Despite this, my one legitimate complaint is the poor quality of the PC port. I had a number of crashes when I played in full screen mode (which had an ugly black box around the screen). Until I played in Windowed mode for the rest of the game. I feel like it could had used a little more time and polish on this end.  Never the less, I enjoyed my time with Nier and would recommend it to anyone.  For the Glory of Mankind

Wolfenstein 3D was a revolutionary game but does it hold up today and would I advise buying and playing it? Well, it's a minimalistic game with limited weapons with each weapon essentially being a faster version of the one that came before it and limited enemy types. There are dogs, weak enemies with pistols, fast enemies with pistols, strong enemies with pistols, a man with a machinegun and armour and numerous functionally identical bosses with 2 or 4 chainguns, perhaps even with a rocket launcher. The AI of the enemies is poor and the battles will often feel cheap. The levels are very linear with very few landmarks, making it difficult to navigate. The graphics quality is also a problem - while pixels are not necessarily bad, it may be hard to differentiate some things and it is advisable to rest your eyes from time to time.  Nonetheless, the game is fun and simple. For anyone looking for a minimal escape from modern gameplay, this game is worth trying out. For anyone who wants to explore FPS history, this game is an obvious starting point. Modern sourceports such as ECWolf and NewWolf have even fixed many graphical problems and added an automap to make things easier. When it came out, it was cutting edge and expensive. Now, it has fallen behind but it's only $5 so why not give it a go? 60 levels and hours of fun. It's terrific value for money.

Самый ад - оптимизация. За нее и палец вниз. Она как минимум худшая за последнее время, если не вообще за всю мою геймерскую карьеру. на моей 3060 Vision + i5 11400 + 32 Gb 3600 CL16 + SSD NVMe при ультра-текстурах и всем остальном высоком (DLSS Качество) игра ухитряется моментами фризить и проседать ниже 60 кадров. При этом я не вижу картинки, которая бы требовала более высокопроизводительной системы. Возвращать не буду, доиграю, все равно уже больше 2 часов прошло в игре. Но это весьма провальный проект, понятия не имею откуда столько положительных отзывов.  Upd. после завершения игры меняю обзор на в основном положительный. Но претензии все те же - недоработанные механики и анимации, душность в некоторых моментах, самоповторы, деревянные второстепенные персонажи. И оптимизация - бесконечные фризы, лаги, просадки. В одной и той же сцене ФПС на указанных выше настройках и конфиге скачет с 110 кадров до 55 и тут же обратно, лаги при сохранениях, один раз в принципе в помещении производительность упала ниже 20 кадров, задорно вернувшись сразу обратно к сотке. Игру нужно было полировать как с технической стороны, так и докрутить гемплейно, сохранив сюжет.  Но поиграть в целом стоит.

Really great game, as you can see I played this alot and I have more hours on the PS4.  The sounds, graphics and story give you a real sense of what it could be like in modern war torn country. The sounds of people crying, running and gun shots, are complimented by the dim, dusty but beautiful visuals of the game.  Along the way you will encounter scenarios where you must decide quickly how will you react, which may make you question your morals.   The game play is point and click and you need to start making your shelter safe and gather food and water, there is no real tutorial in the game so you either work on trail and error or watch a YT tutorial. I honestly played through a few times and figured it out for myself, although no harm in getting some help if needed.   The story in the game is more around each scenario and some characters will show up in the different scenarios you do, as you survive you will find out more background information on the lives of the people you encounter and get to understand why and how they are in the city of Pogoren. All the characters have their own perk, some beneficial and some not so much.   To summarise I think the game is 10/10 for sound, graphics and story, occasionally i found some clicking issues when trying to run away from or hide in the shadows from aggressors, however this didn't happen all the time and I still stand by the game. This game will make you think about the world and how sad war is.

Nach knappen 4 Stunden Spielzeit habe ich das Spiel 2 Tage nach Veröffentlichung durchgespielt. Das Spiel selbst lässt sich am besten als Page-Turner beschreiben, denn es erfordert kein wirkliches Spielgeschick sonder erzählt eine mitreißende Story, die man eigentlich nicht unterbrechen möchte.  Während nahezu das gesamte Spiel mit viel Liebe erdacht und programiert wurde, war das Ende aus meiner Sicht eher enttäuschend. Nachdem ein solcher Spannungsbogen aufgezogen wurde, ließ das Ende doch deutlich zu wünschen übrig.  Auch den Grafikstil würde ich persönlich eher als Comicartig bezeichnen, somit spricht er wohl auch nicht die breite Masse an, wobei ein solcher Stil aus meiner Sicht besser zur Geschichte passte als ein Real-aussehender Stil.  Alles in allem würde ich das Spiel Leuten weiterempfehlen, die sich gerne von einer Story mitreißen lassen und nicht unbedingt alle 2 Sekunden auf etwas Action warten. Allerdings muss ich sagen, finde ich den Preis von 20€ (18€ als ich es erworben habe) doch etwas zu hoch. Somit würde ich Interessenten dazu raten auf einen Sale zu warten bevor ich mir das Spiel kaufe.

Skyrim VR is a bit of a mixed bag, It's skyrim and by now I'm probably on my 20th playthrough and still love it, even without direct mod support plenty of SSE mods still work for skyrim VR too, which is nice.    Skyrim VR makes it blatantly obvious that it wasn't originally made for VR, the bow is missaligned, lockpicking has you use the trackpad on vive rather then grabbing the lockpick with your hands, melee combat feels like it has 0 impact and feels incredibly poor compared to games like Orbus VR, Rec Room or Gorn.  You can't really grab things with your hands, you manipulate objects you hold the same way you would on a 360 controller which is a real shame, and the default walking control scheme though adjustable by fiddling with the game files leaves a lot to be desired, hell you can't even move corpses like you can in every other edition of the game.  All that said - This is skyrim, this is skyrim in VR, and once you wield the power of flame in your hands in the biggest world VR has seen so far, you will forget all its flaws and have an absolute blast playing.    ..... Until you open the inventory and scroll through it awkwardly with your trackpads. Seriously, inventory browsing on vive controllers sucks.  All this said, skyrim VR is the biggest and best experience VR has to offer, even though It's controls are poor, once you get used to them and get lost in the world this will be one of the best VR experiences you will have had up to this point.    You love skyrim? You love VR? You'll love Skyrim VR.

[h1] Introduction [/h1] I can safely say with a doubt that Risk of Rain 2 is a fantastic game to play. The unique cast of survivors, the different skills you can unlock for said survivors, and all of the items in the game have different impacts in which you can play every run in this game.  [h1] The Survivors [/h1] One thing I can say about the survivors is that they are all fun to play. I can't really say I got bored of playing one specific survivor in the game. There's just so many ways to play certain survivors that every time I've played, I've had a new experience for a certain character because of the blessed RNG I have in this game. Some of the survivors from Risk of Rain 1 return to this one with some new additions like MUL-T, REX, the Captain, and Artificer. The new survivors in this game are really fun to play, especially REX and MUL-T in my opinion, you can easily get overpowered runs with these 2. For the returning survivors of the game, they are still a blast as well. Of course I have only 7 hours in the first game compared to my 400+ hours on the second but I still liked the reaction from my friends on the returning characters back when this game's early access released in March.  [h1] The Gameplay [/h1] Very, VERY, solid gameplay. I can't say it enough, I love the game's gameplay so much. I really like rouge-like games and Risk of Rain 2 has not disappointed me in the slightest. From it's enemies, to the maps, to the items that you get, all of it is entertaining to play. One slight problem I have is just the lack of alternate 2nd, 3rd and 4th stage layouts (like the 1st stages have) but this game is getting future updates so I still have high hopes for it. The final stage in this game is very nice to look at and the final boss is pretty bs but that's what you kind of expect for a final boss, always have to have some bs in your game.   [u]Sub category: The Music[/u] This games music is amazing, kudos to Chris Christodoulou because they made a GREAT  soundtrack for the game.  [h1] The Items [/h1] The various items you collect and unlock in this game (in my opinion) have a good purpose for any survivor. Bustling Fungus? Give that to Engineer. Runald's and Kjaro's band? Give that to anyone who can do a big strike of damage like Loader. Backup Magazine? Give that to Artificer. Anyway, you probably get what I'm saying, all of the items have a good purpose, it just depends what survivor is better or worse with it.  [h1] Conclusion [/h1] I recommend this game if you like rouge-likes, a ton of RNG, and if you like a little bs here and there, of course rn there is a few bugs with the 1.0 release of the game, but give Hopoo Games a break here, it's a 3 person dev team, any for that many people, this is an outstanding game.  [u]P.S[/u] I know I got the game for free because of the early release deal but this game is worth every penny. Give it a try, if you don't like it, you can always refund as long as you didn't do a 2+ hour run. ;)

[h1]Хорошие ужастики можно перечислить по пальцам одной руки, уже много лет моду в жанре задают всего несколько компаний, чьи произведения давно обрели культовый статус, а каждая новая часть гарантированно сметается с полок вне зависимости от качества исходного продукта. Настоящий джентльмен (даром что пролетарий) Айзек отказать не смог, поэтому случилось, то что случилось... Ничего хорошего.  [quote]«Почему нет связи? Кто-то же должен быть на таком большом корабле?» наивно удивляется наш тиммейт, спец по компьютерным системам Кендра Дэниелс. О да, крошка, там полно народу! [/quote]  Создатели не стали томить игрока долгими прологами - action начинается сразу же после приземления. [b]«Отрезай им конечности!»[/b] написал безымянный доброжелатель на стене обственной кровью. Спасибо мужик! Родина тебя не забудет. Берем резак и приступаем к шинковке мутагенной мертвечины. Ein sehr interessantes und witziges Spiel, das mehr als erwartet mit dem richtigen Schach zu tun hat. Es ist auf jeden Fall empfehlenswert die Grundlagen und die Regeln des Schachspiels zu kennen, da man durch diese enorme Vorteile für das Spiel besitzt. Durch diese fällt es dem Spieler deutlich leichter das vorgegebene Ziel in den mindest Zügen zu schaffen. Zwar besitzt das Spiel auch ein Tutorial, welches erklärt wie die Figuren jeweils ziehen, aber für einen Spieler ohne Vorahnung ist es extrem schwierig in so eine schnelle Zeit sich alles zu merken. Die Aufgaben der verschiedenen Stellungen sind kreativ ausgedacht. Oft ist es nicht so einfach das Ziel zu erreichen wie erwartet.  Sowohl die Animationen der 16 Figuren auf jeder Seite ist ebenfalls gut gemacht. Es enthält ebenfalls verschiedene Spielmodi, die auch bei dem Mehrspielermodus dem schwächeren Spieler eine Chance geben, da die Figuren z.B. zufällig plaziert werden. Alles in allem ist es ein gelungenes Spiel, dass die Spaßigkeit und Freude von Schach gut darstellt. Einzig allein der Mehrspielermodus könnte verbessert werden, indem es auch möglich ist via Internet gegen andere zu spielen und nicht nur per LAN oder auf einem Rechner.

35MM is an atmospheric walking simulator with a shallow story.  I'll start of with the pros: + The game looks good in different outdoor environments and in the first few houses that you visit. Especially if you've actually visited houses like this. I'm talking to you, Eastern Europeans and Russians.  + The premise is extremely interesting. + Manages to make moments that shouldn't be scary, scary.  + The game manages to be scary WITHOUT JUMPSCARES. That's a huge plus for me.  And off to the bigger amount of cons: - The story never explores the main reason why everything is the way it is. - Most things that happen are either awfully explained just not explained at all. - The localization sucks. This is some of the worst translating I've ever seen.  - Audio glitches. When characters speak, then sometimes their mouths move, yet nothing comes out. Subtitles still work, so it's the game's fault, not me being crazy. - Animations are slow and jerky.  - Small gripe, but the fonts just look so unprofessional. It's like reading a term paper, that's been written in Arial. It just looks ugly.  - Most items aren't interactable even though they should, like drawers. Some can be opened, some cannot. - Excessant amount of invisible walls.  - And the last, but most definitely not the least... the fetch quests. The game has you walk around, just looking for things ad nauseum. In a few cases it's definitely great. Like when you look for a bucket for water in the middle of the night. It makes no sense, but it worked. Or the next day in the same village when you know someone was there when you were waterhunting and now have to find gasoline in the same village, not knowing whether the person is still there.   So... the cons overtake the pros heavily. But why did I still recommend this? Well, the reason is the huge amount of *memorable* moments. I can list 4 off the top of my head. That's way better than most games. To compare: a huge game like L.A. Noire only had 2 memorable moments for me. And that game's 3-4 times the length of 35MM at least.   Overall: 6/10 - Barely above average (All games start at a 5/10 and the grade goes up/down based on the pros/cons)

Эта игра заинтересовала меня прежде всего огромными сисищами на заставке. Суть игры типична для всех молодежных фильмов – вы на вечеринке и жаждите nи3дятинки.  По началу было очень забавно, бегаешь по дому, разговариваешь с телками в духе «Разреши припарковать мой красный Харлей в твоем гараже» А когда я узнал, что можно светить х\у\ец, то уже собирался подать заявку на номинацию «Игра года» Далее подпоил энергичную nи3досю, после чего она скинула платье и танцевала в одних трусах. У другой сдернул бретельки, обнажив грудь и она побежала через весь дом в ванну, тряся ею.  Уже положили игру в корзину ? Не торопись товарищ !  Крайне печалит оптимизация, она ОЧЕНЬ плохая. Однако это все поправимо.  Графика и дизайн. При том, что действие происходит на площади 1 дома с задним двором и в нем меньше 10 персонажей, иметь такой примитивный уровень проработки стыдно. Модельки кажется взяты из секс игр. Анимация, детализация, физика тел на уровне 2005 года. (Кто-то крикнул: «Не томи ! Что с сиськами ?!) Отвечаю: Я подробно изучил этот вопрос, сиси симпатичные, но физики нет, просто перемещается текстура соска\одежды, создавая иллюзию движения груди. (Кто-то крикнул: «Может это силикон ?») Отвечаю: Нет мэн, они будто припаяны. По твоему в жoпе тоже силикон ?  Это одна из самых больших проблем данного продукта. В игре про коитус, вместо персонажей, какие-то пластмассовые куклы. Нужна физика тел, волос, ткани(одежды), чтобы возрастал уровень вожделения, только то того, как она прошла рядом.  Второе, что делает персонажей неживыми это их поведение. Они рандомно передвигаются по дому, кто-то не встает со стула, кто-то танцует не останавливаясь, никто не уходит и не приходит. Создается впечатление, что попал в ловушку в духе «Пила» или в чистилище. Диалоги примитивны, линии развития однообразны и не проработаны. Все, чего мне удалось добиться я описал в начале, никому даже за щеку не завел. Взаимодействие кончилось, когда я испробовал все возможные варианты диалога.  Никудышные звук и музыка. Голоса девок слишком искусственные и не вызывают никакого отклика в паховой области. Стереосистема все время играет какое-то унылое гoвнo, можно было приобрести пару клубных, танцевальных треков.  Оказалось, что можно потеребить вялого. Леха Панин одобряет. Я даже спустил на человека, шучу, на женщину. Никто даже не отбежал, видимо привыкли. Но было это как-то неинтересно, без энтузиазма. Meiner Erfahrung nach lohnt es sich auch überaus es öfters durchzuspielen, da die vielen Enden und Spielweisen ausprobiert werden möchten. Außerdem bietet die aktive Modding-Community stets Abwechslung und Verbesserungen, welche dem Spiel mehr Feuer bringen.  Meiner Meinung nach eines der besten Spiele aller Zeiten. First off, it's really hard to write an unbiased review becuase I have played DMC3 and DMC4, and yes, I was kinda disappointed at how childish and totally oblivious this new Dante is, compared to the one before. Character-wise, I'd the say the one thing that put me off a little bit at the beginning is how Vergil was apparently doing the right thing and Dante didn't give a shit about freeing humanity. That's not the Dante I knew. I was almost horrified at what the reboot brought me. However, after finishing the game on multiple difficulties, my opinions changed a bit, hopefully you'll agree with them.  [b][h1]Rating : 8/10 [/h1][/b]  The game has one of the weakest storylines I've ever come across, and I myself could probably have written a better one, but the combat outshines almost certainly, ALL of it's predecessors. It's a bit easier, since some enemies can only be killed with a certain type of weapon, so you end up getting more points without having to hitch up a crazy combo, but it's absolutely insane how flawlessly enemies can be juggled together. Almost every enemy can be parried, which makes one want to play one the higher difficulties just to feel less like a god. And not in a bad way, because it's not that easy, really.  [b]Major pros of the game :[/b]  [b]+Animations :[/b] Being dragged into Limbo City is visually breathtaking, every single time [b]+Traversal :[/b] It's a lot smoother, and more believable to be honest [b]+Combat :[/b] Obviously, this is like 95% why people are recommending the game [b]+Soundtrack :[/b] Holy shit, the soundtrack's awesome. Noisia and CombiChrist! I love both! [b]+Performance :[/b] Excellent, no stupid crashes till date, no nothing. If it runs on my potato, you can run it too. [b]+Devil Trigger :[/b] The Devil Trigger of the reboot is really cool. Not to mention that you deal a sh!tton of damage too. [b]+Level Design :[/b] Another thing I should mention, it's really well done. [b]+Training Mode :[/b] It's really cool feature where you can try out combos on dummy enemies. It's much cooler than it sounds, check it out. [b]+New Difficulties :[/b] I won't spoil anything, check them out. [b]+Bloody Palace Mode :[/b] Yeah!! It's available as a free DLC, which is great!! [b]+Less sexualization :[/b] One thing that used to put me off a little bit was how the women in Devil May Cry were overly sexualized, as if the target audience was solely composed of couch potatoes with no lives. Kat, in this game is a much welcome change. I'm not saying this is a game for 6 year olds, but a lot of the unnecessary sexualization has been done away with, and I second that. [b]+Vergil's combat style is on point :[/b] That's another tiny thing I noticed, and liked. Dante and Vergil have vastly different fight styles. That's even more obvious if you get the [i]Vergil's Downfall[/i] DLC, because you get to play as Vergil. [b]+Excellent Motion Capture :[/b] If you watch closely you'll get to appreciate how well done this is. It's truly reminiscent of the earlier [i]Devil May Cry[/i] titles. I loved it.  [b]Now, cons :[/b] [b]-Characters :[/b] Maybe because I've played DMC before, but this game was a disappointment because of the lack of a good story. You can almost forget the game has a story, after completing it on the first playthrough. There's also a general lack of compelling characters, aside from Mundus, the main villian. There's also little known about Kat, aside from the fact that she had a troubled childhood and uses squirrel s*m*n in her magic. [b]-Humour :[/b] Dante used to be a comical genius, in DMC4 he was a total menace, I have to say, and I used to enjoy that about him.               Now, this new Dante takes himself a bit too seriously, and he's kinda out to take revenge to be honest (at least that's what he supposed to do) so we don't get that. It's not like there's no humour, but it's adult humour, lots of well placed f*** you's and a bunch of swearing. This makes him less sexy in my opinion, but we'll have to deal with it. [b]-Swearing :[/b] This is very minor to me, because I'm 20 and it really doesn't matter to me, and to be honest, the comic timings are always on point. But it's way too American-ish, in my opinion. Gone are the days where Dante would totally roast his opponent with witty punchlines, here he just swears at them. [spoiler]^Implies he's a lot less smart, anyway.[/spoiler] [b]-Vergil's a pu$$y :[/b] I can't stress this enough. Throughout the game, Vergil seems to overly rely on Dante for all the fighting, inspite of carrying the Yamato everywhere. He can hack and sh!t, but he can't fight to save his life. I didn't like that big a difference in power between Dante and Vergil. It's like, Dante's the hothead who doesn't know what he's doing, and Vergil's the pussy who's yelling instructions. ^This wasn't throughout the entirety of the game, though. I'm only saying this because I wanted a much more badass Vergil, the type of guy you can love and hate at the same time. [b]-Not a 100% PC Game :[/b] No surprises there, like all of it's predecessors, it's played best with a controller. I had some difficulties navigating because the game kinda get's over-saturated with the information that the mouse sends. I'm not saying it's a major flaw, it's just not CS:GO. :P  [h1][b]Final Verdict :[/b][/h1]  Buy it. No need to 100% it, buy it to enjoy it. Because, despite failing as a strong [i]Devil May Cry[/i] game, it's definitely among the very best when it comes to hack and slash titles. If you love hack and slash, you won't complete your collection without it. If you've never played DMC before, you might even enjoy the story. If you're a DMC fan, and a [b]Ruben Langdon[/b][spoiler]the coolest guy in history![/spoiler] loyalist, you'll get triggered, like I was. But that didn't stop me from enjoying the game. At the end of the day, it's a solid hack and slash title, and Ninja Theory, for the record, are some pretty badass people in their own right. I hope this was helpful.

The trailer for this game is exactly what you get, so if you enjoyed it, you will enjoy this game. It is a combat-based action RPG in the style of an older Diablo game with a focus on straightforwardness, simplicity, and an absurd, lovable, and cartoonish style. The main character, Rick, is a melee fighter that you can augment by choosing different stats and items to wear.  Like Diablo, the fun of the game is in beating things up and finding items.  Rick accomplishes both of these by slamming his knife into enemies until they die in Rogue-like fashion. The strategy comes how you plan ahead by choosing what to wear, what to carry, where to stand, etc. rather than the actual combat, which is mostly just your stats comparing with the monsters and deciding how to use your consumable items. You also have a special meter that can be used to give yourself a boost for a short time. It's easy to understand and enjoyable.  Once you finish the game, you can try again with a different character and a stat focus. There are 9 or 10 special abilities you can pick as you level, some of which are passive. You can have up to 4, but some of them won't be relevant for the way you're playing. For example, I wouldn't choose a power like Flash (which uses your special meter to teleport you) on a character focused on Strength and Speed because I would never have enough Willpower to use it consistently. Or similiarly, I wouldn't choose Eagle Eye (which raises your attack rating and critical hit rate) on a character with a high Dexterity because I would already be hitting everything accurately and it would be redundant. You can choose a special ability to focus on one path, use in an emergency, or to balance out a weakness. There are enough different combinations and achievements to play through the game several times if you want.  If the store page appeals to you and you're looking for a light, enjoyable game, I recommend this. It's exactly what it looks like and it has enough depth for me to enjoy 90+ hours.

When compared to its predecessor, Rome II comes up short. How short depends on who you ask. For me I have played every Total War game since the original Shogun. The great thing about the games leading up to this one is the indepth feel. You are the King. You are the one making every decision. You feel invensted in the time you've spent to create the empire you want. The downfall of Rome II, other than its many technical shortcomings (ie crashes, bad AI, etc.) is the fact that you are not really connected to any of your generals, you are not really connected to any of your populace, your cities don't feel strategically important, there are no internal power struggles or polotics, in sum it feels like everything is 'just there'. There is nothing tying you into the game.  As opposed to many other gamers, I did not have any graphical issues and to me the game looks great. The scope of the map is incredible, and the battles, though to quick without mods, are generally good, though AI could be better. The lack of cohesivness to the experience is troubling. The political system is a shame to Creative Assembly, as im sure they are aware. The Diplomacy suffers from a lack of authenticity and adaptability. The family system from Rome I is gone entirely.   In total not a terrible game but definitively underwhelming for a Total War Game.

**ENSURE YOUR NVIDIA SETTINGS HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED PROPERLY**  This review will get amended once I have played more, but firstly; I'm seeing several other 4080 owners with better CPUs seeing lower FPS in game than me. What I have done is to tweak the Nvidia control panel settings to improve performance, which I cannot see evidence of other 4080 owners having done, and may contribute to their restricted performance stats. In addition, I've activated the resizable BAR in my PC BIOS. Ok, that last bit is not going to give me performance percentage increases in the double figures but every little bit helps.   PC stats: CPU - 11400F (no OC'ing possible) GPU - 4080 (OC'ed to 2910MHz GPU clock and 22802MHz memory clock at 1070mV, resizable BAR enabled in BIOS) RAM - 2x16GB 3600MHz DDR4 (XMP enabled on BIOS) Game installed on M.2 1TB PCIE 4.0   I have a 60Hz 4k monitor so I limit my max FPS to 60 to avoid shearing, and in game, my FPS shows as 59-60 average with lowest at 49, and GPU temp at 51*C.   Jedi Survivor settings: - 4k res - all settings on epic - RT is on  - motion blur is off as it makes me queasy  Nvidia Control Panel settings (those that are different to standard): Ambient Occlusion - Quality Anisotropic filtering - 16x Antialiasing Mode - Enhance the application setting Antialiasing Setting - 8x Antialiasing Transparency - 8x (supersample) DSR Factors - 4.00x DSR Smoothness - 100% Low latency mode - Off Max Frame Rate - 60 FPS MFAA - On Power management mode - Prefer maximum performance Texture filtering Negative LOD bias - Clamp Texture filtering Quality - High quality Triple buffering - On  No, my PC is not affected by The Force so, having higher than 30 FPS is not magic, it is a matter of adjusting your GPU settings from standard to what works best.  As for my initial thoughts on the game: - Having played Fallen Order a month back, the in game controls are nearly identical and thus it felt like I was playing an expansion to the original, but that does NOT do justice to the complexity of the game, which is massively expanded in comparison to Fallen Order - You can now add skill points to multiple trees when stopping at meditation spots - Multiple stances allow for better approaches to combat, with two that can be switched between whilst in combat - The visuals? Oh my.... This game feels bigger. In Fallen Order, you never got the sense of being on a populated planet. Not the case in Jedi Survivor. The visuals of Coruscant in the opening chapter are immensely detailed, there is so much speeder/ship traffic, you know you're not alone, and when you start descending to the initial drop off point, you get a feel for how far above the surface of the planet the tops of skyscrapers are. We're talking miles/kilometres high!   More to follow as I get more game time racked up!

Знаете, я могу попробовать описать свое состояние, после прохождения этой игры с практически всеми доп. заданиями, которые я нашел. Обзор я решил написать сразу же, после окончания титров. Так вот мое состояние было примерно такое: ничего не понимающий овощ, открытый рот, широко раскрытые глаза, дыхание замерло, выражение некоего смешанного чувства ужаса и эйфории. Я испытывал нереально классные чувства, практически неописуемые, когда я увидел последнюю заставку и убедился в этом окончательно. Я был в восторге от столь прекрасной истории и в небывалом ужасе, от осознания того, что я играл в эту игру 48 часов подряд, считая перерывы на сон и еду. История и в правду очень интересная, я не буду писать в чем заключается ее суть, но скажу, что если начать играть с Divine Divinity и после прохождения ее сразу же начать проходить Beyond Divinity, а за ней и саму Divinity 2, то можно оказаться на седьмом небе от счастья. Это серия великолепных рпг, которые рассказывают великолепную историю о спасении мира от сил зла. Мне в этой игре не понравилось разве, что кривоватое управление, но оно практически не влияет на игровой опыт. В игре, для меня, идеально все, начиная от главного меню и заканчивая сраными титрами. Когда я нажал кнопку новая игра и начал создавать персонажа, мне нравилось все, я создал себе рыженькую и худенькую воительницу. В самой же игре мне очень нравился дизайн самих локаций. Каждая крупная локация врезалась мне в мозг, чего стоит только вход в храм Махоса, когда я его увидел, у меня пробежали мурашки по спине. Далее я хочу отметить музыку, она подобрана под все виды локаций и это прекарсно, она радует своим звучанием уши, у меня ниразу не возникло ощущения, что что-то не так, в этой мелодии, все подходило под ситуации. Далее я хочу отметить прокачку персонажа, к 25-40 ты можешь быть машиной для убийств, регенерирующей машиной для убийств, которая призывает демона и лупит всех дубиной с минимальным домагом в 400 поинтов, а если сюда добавить вампиризм,и повышенный шанс критов и уклонения, то тебя просто невозмодно уничтожить. Далее я хочу отметить озвучку. Если мне не изменяет память, то игру переводили 1С Snowball. На мой взгляд, эти ребята превзошли сами себя, озвучка иеальна и я буду так считать не смотря ни на что. Так о чем это я, ах да! Я хотел уже закончить этот обзор, так как у меня на часах 6 утра и я сильно хочу спать, так вот Divinity 2 великолепный представитель жанра, я еще не играл ни во что похожее на серию этих игр в общем. Прохождение этой игры сравнимо у меня с прохождение таких игр как: Warcraft 3 и Diablo 2-это мои две самые любимые игры, которые я проходил много раз и к ним добавилась еще и вся серия игр Divinity! (пока что только до второй части, но Original sin уже устанавливается на мой жесткий диск и я надеюсь, что она тоже не подведет) Теперь точно заключение. Divinity 2 безусловно стоит своих денег, я рекомендую ее всем и каждому, кто любит жанр RPG, кто не прочь получать свитком с хорошей историей ближайшие 20 часов (мне кажется это минимум, который только возможен), кому нравится кромсать толпы врагов на право и на лево и кто готов выполнять однотипные задания не похожие ни на одно предыдущее, которые вы выполнили в этой игре. I seriously recommend RimWorld. I purchased it almost a year ago and I can say with confidence that every penny that I've spent on this game, I've earned back. Every time that I launch RimWorld, I prepare myself for a roller coaster of emotions. The stories that this game has produced always enthrall me, and I'm always inclined to play just [i]one more[/i] hour so I can see how my colony develops. I've surpassed hundreds of milestones I've set for myself and have spent real days watching my colonies grow and prosper. On top of the captivating gameplay, RimWorld is also a very well-optimized game. While playing completely vanilla (i.e., unmodded) I can easily run the game at 60 FPS on my Surface Laptop 2. It's also enticing to those who travel a lot because an internet connection is not required to run the game! I'm happy knowing that anywhere I am, I can boot up RimWorld and get lost in a world of my own.  On top of the extensive stock gameplay, the modding community is vast and active. Every day a new mod is produced and available on the workshop that you would just [i]love[/i] to see in your next playthrough. The spectrum for the category of mods is endless as well, ranging from simple quality of life (QoL) mods to complete overhauls and transformations of the Rim as you know it. There's also a lot of mods to fit every niche. During my dozens of hours browsing the workshop, I've seen Mass Effect, Halo, anime, Star Wars, Call of Duty, [i]Minecraft[/i], WW2, WW1, Warframe, Lord of The Rings, and so many more-themed mods. And once you start modding, its not too long before your mod list exceeds 100, then 200, then 300, then 400. Currently, I play with 487 mods. My game can barely run so many different mods on my low-end laptop but I wouldn't have it any other way.  Not to mention the fantastic community. With community hubs across several mainstream platforms such as Reddit, Discord, and Twitter, the community always welcomes newcomers with open arms. I remember coming in clueless as to how to have a successful colony in this game and veterans of the game were quick to list out tips and tricks and link to helpful guides and YouTube videos. The friendliness and excitement that the players of this game is something I have not seen in any other community.  In two sentences, RimWorld is simply astonishing. Simply worth a purchase.

[h1]Une adaptation parfaite... mais de gros défauts[/h1]  On retrouve tout ce qu'on aime du jeu de plateau en termes d'ambiance, de couleur, et de beauté. Le jeu est assez poétique et charmant, la BO choisi concorde très bien avec l'atmosphère zen du jeu, les animations sont celles que l'on peut s'attendre à voir de la part de nos personnages asiatiques préférés. L'univers irisé et chatoyant de Takenoko est bel et bien présent. Un Tutoriel qui enseigne rapidement et simplement les règles pour mieux se plonger rapidement dans les vraies parties. Une interface joli et pratique bien que standard.  Bref que du bon me direz vous ? Oui, mais hélas, non.  le jeu souffre de deux problèmes majeurs... :  1) Il est mal équilibré dans le sens où il me paraît très difficile de gagner contre les Pandabots. En tout cas, c'est beaucoup  plus difficile que contre de vrais joueur. Il me semble qu'ils ont systématiquement plus de chance que moi sur les pioches et sur la météo. Ce n'est pas que je n'aime pas le challenge, c'est plutôt que je n'ai gagné qu'une seule partie sur la vingtaine jouée, ce qui ne m'arrive jamais avec le jeu de plateau. Alors soit le jeu est trop dur, soit je suis un chouineur, ou un gros nul. Dans les deux derniers cas, que quelqu'un me le dise svp, que je puisse au moins me faire soigner.   2) Malheureusement les serveurs en ligne semblent bien vide. ce n'est pourtant pas faute d'avoir réalisé un jeu très beau et sympathique. Heureusement que l'on peut jouer en local.  ... Et de trois problèmes mineurs:  1) les animations sont sympas, mais lentes, trop lentes. C'est beau au début puis on a vite envie de pouvoir accélérer les choses, c'est à dire les animations elles même ainsi que les tours des autre joueurs (quand ce sont des bots bien sûr). Il faut aussi systématiquement valider en cliquant qu'on a bien compris que tel joueur a fait telle action...   2) L'impossibilité de voir ses cartes objectifs à tout moment est handicapante quand il s'agit de choisir en fonction d'elles mais que l'on ne peut pas les voir avant d'avoir choisi justement (la météo par exemple)  3) une traduction française imparfaite, concernant les succès surtout   [h1] conseil aux dev [/h1] [list] [*] un joueur qui perd systématiquement est un joueur qui arrête de jouer, qu'il soit bon ou mauvais joueur c'est pareil. Takenoko n'a sûrement pas vocation à être un [i]try-hard.[/i] Proposez nous des niveaux de difficultés, s'il vous plaît. Celle qui existe actuellement est peut-être approprié pour les meilleur d'entre nous, mais elle est surement bien inaccessible à la majorité. [*] Faites que l'on puisse voir nos objectifs en permanence, car faire un choix obligatoirement à l'aveugle est très handicapant et frustrant, et ça peut faire la différence entre une victoire et une défaite. [*] Mettez en place, s'il vous plaît, une option pour accélérer les animations en général ainsi que les tours des pandabots, voir de carrément les passer pour arriver de suite à son tour. Comme on peut voir tout ce que possède chaque joueur à tout instant, ce n'est pas un problème pour les personnes expérimentées qui veulent faire des parties plus rapide. [*] Supprimer ou donner nous la possibilité de supprimer dans les options les confirmations systématiques des actions des autres joueurs. Cela fluidifierait le jeu. [*] si vos serveur en ligne crashes trop régulièrement vous ne risquez pas de les voir se remplir. C'est dommage. (je n'ai pas constaté cela personnellement mais d'autres évaluations le suggère) [*] c'est beaucoup moins important, mais une traduction correcte, même sur des éléments pas essentiels comme les succès est toujours appréciée. [/list] [u]Bravo pour le côté artistique du jeu qui est superbe ![/u]  [h1] Malgré tout [/h1] Je recommande ce jeu, qui est une adaptation particulièrement bien réussie du jeu de plateau. Quand ses quelques défauts seront corrigés, le jeu sera une vraie réussite, et même un modèle à suivre pour l'adaptation de jeu de plateau en jeu vidéo.  [b]Notez que tous les défaut que j'ai mentionné, bien que rédhibitoires à la longue, n'empêche à priori pas d'avoir une expérience agréable sur Takenoko.[/b]

Dead by Daylight, сто пудов, задумывалась как вселяющая ужас игра с ассиметричным мультиплеером. И разработчики, наверняка оценив опыт Evolve, решили выдать такой продукт, который не загнется в ближайшие месяцы. Это оказалось не так сложно и, походу, игра пока на плаву.  Секрет заключается в том, что четверо жертв, являются настоящими жертвами. Они способны только убегать и оттягивать неизбежное — свою смерть. Если повезет, конечно, жертвы спасутся, убегут далеко-далеко в лобби, затем соберутся снова и вновь кинутся в авантюру с генераторами и безумным маньяком. Генераторы они жуть как любят и покидать покои монстра до тех пор, пока не заведут их штук пять даже не подумают. А еще они любят бегать от маньяков и бросать ему под ноги всякий мусор, чтобы тому было противно следовать за жертвой по пятам. Но монстр не любит генераторы, он любит жертв и потому бегает за ними с особым усердием и таки насаживает на свой…постамент для жертв. И такой вот любовный треугольник будет преследовать игроков до тех пор пока они не станут закаленными засранцами. В такие моменты мрачные декорации и пыхтящий маньяк уже не так страшны.  Дело обстоит так — я поиграл в игру ровно столько, чтобы перестать напрягаться от беснующегося маньяка за спиной. Геймплей меня порадовал, но с друзьями у меня не получалось нормально побегать, периодически игра вообще отказывалась включаться, сообщая что она скачивает античит клиент и на том и останавливалась. В итоге я перешел на трансляции и вот особенно уделил внимание тем, кто наиграл миллионы (сотни) часов в  Dead by Daylight.  https://youtu.be/qCABqsoHlH4  Картина такова, что даже при том условии, что жертвы казалось бы беззащитны, а монстр быстрая детина с особым перком, спустя сотни часов все переворачивается с ног на голову. Это совершенно новая игра. Теперь это не охотник за четырмя несчастными людишками, теперь это злобные тролли, которые не дают маньяку выполнять свою работу. И как ни прикручивай баланс, достигнуть его совершенно не возможно. Убить хоть кого-то (то есть до конца довести дело с учетом жертвоприношения) почти нереально. Монстра кайтят и стопят. И это настоящий электрический стул для того, кто выбрал игру за нападающего. Зато закаляет.  Dead by Daylight это прямо-таки два в одном. Сперва страшно и сложно за жертв, а чем дальше тем страшнее и сложнее за маньяка.  Кураторство - http://store.steampowered.com/curator/5763270/
