Сюжет За Бэтмена Сюжет Arkham City начинается через полтора года после событий Arkham Asylum[2]. Квинси Шарп, бывший надзиратель психиатрической больницы Аркхэм, заработал огромную известность за поимку Джокера и, пользуясь этим, стал мэром Готэма. Так как Аркхэм и тюрьма «Блэкгейт» были не в состоянии содержать заключённых, новый мэр первым своим делом выкупил огромную территорию трущоб Готэма. Он создал там тюрьму под названием «Arkham City», а по периметру этой территории поставил хорошо вооруженный отряд наёмников «ТАЙГЕР», которым был отдан приказ стрелять на поражение при попытке побега. Заключенные, прибывшие в «Аркхэм-Сити» предоставлены сами себе, пока не попытаются сбежать. Для осуществления надзора за заключенными Шарп нанял на пост надзирателя психиатра Хьюго Стрэнджа. Многие были недовольны таким развитием событий, в том числе и Брюс Уэйн. Бэтмен постоянно присматривает за новой тюрьмой, опасаясь, что всё может выйти из-под контроля[3]. Планы строительства «Аркхэм-Сити» есть в потайной комнате, соединенной с кабинетом Шарпа в психбольнице Аркхэм[4].  Во время одного из протестов Уэйна похищают наёмники из организации «ТАЙГЕР», которые приводят его прямиком к Стрейнджу, который знает, что Брюс — это Бэтмен, и говорит о том, что теперь он готов запустить нечто под названием «Протокол 10». Брюса ведут мимо взбешённых заключённых. Во время одного такого перехода его оглушают люди Пингвина, у которого личные счёты с Брюсом. В ходе потасовки с Пингвином Уэйну удаётся освободиться от наручников и убежать. Он связывается с Альфредом, который высылает ему всё оборудование. Перехватив радиопередачу о том, что Женщина-кошка захвачена Двуликим, Бэтмен вычисляет его координаты и отправляется в резиденцию Дента — бывшее здание суда.  Прибыв на место, Бэтмен видит, как Двуликий собирается утопить Женщину-кошку в чане с кислотой. Одолев его людей, Бэтмен успевает спасти её и обезвредить Харви. Тёмный Рыцарь пытается узнать у неё что-либо по поводу «Протокола 10», о котором говорил Стрейндж. Их разговор прерывает снайперская пуля, пущенная Джокером, которая едва не убивает Женщину-кошку. Бэтмен сканирует траекторию полёта пули и направляется в колокольню церкви, откуда и был произведён выстрел. Там к нему по телевизору обращается Джокер. Однако колокольня оказывается заминирована, и Бэтмен успевает спастись всего за несколько секунд до взрыва. Он направляется в логово Джокера — сталелитейный завод Sionis Industries. Там его настойчиво пытаются остановить наёмники Джокера и сама Харли Квинн. Бэтмен всё же находит Джокера, который сидит уже при смерти в инвалидном кресле. Внезапно Тёмного Рыцаря оглушают. Джокер, медленно умирающий из-за передозировки «Титана», заражает Бэтмена, перелив ему свою кровь, чтобы тот нашёл противоядие для них обоих. Однако это ещё не вся беда. Клоун отправил свою заражённую кровь во все больницы Готэма, так что всё население в опасности.  Бэтмен отправляется за Мистером Фризом, который изготовлял лекарство для Джокера, но перестал это делать. Детектив находит его лабораторию в полицейском участке. Расправившись с людьми Пингвина, он узнает что сам Кобблпот держит Фриза в своем штабе — музее естественной истории. Бэтмен проникает в музей и с помощью Фриза достает Пингвина. После этого Кобблпот достает из рукава свой козырь — зомби Соломона Гранди. С трудом одолев его, Темный Рыцарь добивает Пингвина и освобождает Фриза. Сам же Фриз сообщает ему, что лекарства нет. Ему нужен последний ингредиент, который содержится в крови Ра’с аль Гула.  Бэтмен проникает в Лигу убийц, проходит их испытания, сталкивается с самим Ра’с аль Гулом и получает образец крови. Он приносит его Фризу, однако тот не намерен отдавать Бэтмену лекарство, поскольку Фриз думает, что после того, как Бэтмен получит лекарство, он не будет помогать ему найти его жену, Нору похищенную Джокером. Между Мистером Фризом и Бэтменом завязывается бой. Проиграв, Фриз всё-таки собирается отдать лекарство, но его уже похитила Харли Квинн. Бэтмен собирается вернуть лекарство, и для этого проникает на сталелитейный завод, и вступает в схватку с Джокером и его прихвостнями. Бэтмен одерживает победу, но оказывается прижат обломками рухнувшего потолка. Джокер готовится добить его, но его останавливает Талия аль Гул, и предлагает Джокеру источник бессмертия. Бэтмен пытается этому помешать, но из-за удара Джокера теряет сознание. Джокер не знает, что Талия активировала маячок, чтобы их нашёл Бэтмен. Хьюго Стрэндж, узнав где находится Уэйн, отправляет за ним своих людей, но Женщина-кошка их опережает. Она помогает Бэтмену подняться, и говорит, что если он хочет остановить Стрейнджа, ему следует поторопиться.  Тем временем, «Протокол 10» вступает в силу. Темный Рыцарь узнает его значение: Стрейндж собирает всех преступников Готэма в одном месте и отдает приказ вертолетам «Тигр» обстреливать его, уничтожая преступников. Бэтмен проникает в Чудо-башню, где засел Стрейндж и деактивирует протокол. Ра’с аль Гул, стоявший за всеми действиями Стрейнджа, убивает его, так как он ни чем не отличается от других злодеев. Перед смертью, Хьюго активирует «Протокол 11» (бомбу, которая была на башне). Бэтмен и Ра’с аль Гул успевают выпрыгнуть, за секунду до взрыва. Бэтмен ловит в полете Ра’с аль Гула, чтобы он не разбился, но тот протыкает себя своим же мечом, пытаясь достать и Бэтмена, так что тому приходится отцепиться, и разбивается насмерть. Неожиданно на экране появляется сообщение Джокера, в котором он говорит, что похитил Талию’аль Гул и убьет её, если Бэтмен не явится на представление, устроенное клоуном, под названием «Бессмертный Джокер».  Бэтмен прибывает в театр, где Талия неожиданно убивает Джокера мечом и отдает Бэтмену лекарство. Бэтмен вспоминает всё, что произошло с ним по прибытии в Аркхэм-Сити. Он понимает, что его опять обманули. Кто-то стреляет в Талию сзади, убийцей оказывается Джокер. Талия забрала лекарство у Харли Квинн, а значит, что Джокер по прежнему болен. Все это время клоуну помогал Глиноликий, притворясь Джокером. Бэтмен сражается с Глиноликим, и побеждает его с помощью криогенных гранат, которые ему дал Фриз. Бэтмен перекрывает путь к источнику бессмертия телом Глиноликого, после чего выпивает половину противоядия, оставив другую половину Джокеру. Джокер атакует Бэтмена сзади, и случайно разбивает пробирку с лекарством. Он в ужасе пытается выпить хоть что-то, но не получается. Джокер думает, что Бэтмен доволен тем, что злодей умрет. Но Тёмный Рыцарь говорит, что если бы у него был шанс спасти его, он бы сделал это не колеблясь. Джокер говорит что это действительно смешно, и умирает.  Бэтмен выносит тело Джокера из театра, и остолбеневшие бандиты просто пропускают его. Бэтмен выходит из Аркхэм-Сити, и встречает полицейских во главе с Джеймсом Гордоном. Бэтмен кладёт тело Джокера на машину. Гордон спрашивает Бэтмена о том, что произошло. Но герой молча уходит, игра заканчивается.  В середине титров раздаётся голос из коммуникатора, уведомляющий Бэтмена о пропущенном звонке, имевшем место три часа назад, а затем слышен голос Джокера, который поёт песню «Only You (And You Alone)» группы The Platters и злобно хихикает в конце неё.

I remember playing the Rebuild 1 and 2 flash games so much back in the day. It was such a breath of fresh air for the zombie genre that was filled to the brim with just first/third person shooters, or just Dayz clones. The gameplay was very addicting and fun, the amount of choices you can make and how much of an impact they can cause were astounding, and the story kept me wanting to come back and play more. In my opinion, Rebuild 3: Gangs of Deadsville truly makes an ambitious take on the Rebuild series. It has such a huge difference compared to the other two, bringing in more factions, adding much more scenarios and options, you can play in turn based or real time, whichever floats your boat, and characters can have their own perks, and even a backstory as well. The story is pretty interesting as well, a group of rag tag survivors outnumbered one billion to one by zombies, trying to rebuild society and civilization, and HOW they will as well. You can completely chose how your people behave, what government you run, how you treat other factions, and how your adventure will go and end as well. The atmosphere of the game feels like a journey, balancing itself with some humor, adventure, mystery, and some thriller as well. I understand why some players or fans of the rebuild series might not like the art style, but in my opinion, I really like the art style. Survivors and characters all have their nice, unique look to them, and I like the colorful backgrounds and environment as well since it kinda makes it feel alive. There's two modes where you can play, story mode, and basically a mode where you rebuild your own city that you choose. I do admit that it can get a bit repetitive after a while, and their should be much more different scenarios for each city. But to be honest, I think this game is pretty good. It's a good starter for management strategy game rookies, and a good fresh breath of air for the zombie genre. Some fans of the original may like it, some may not, and I respect that. The price is a bit iffy for how much it really gives in replayability, but its really worth it when discounted well.

[h1] Эффектная Стерва против 7 смертных грехов [/h1] [h1] Сюжет: [/h1] вот и приключение харизматичной, шутливой и стервозной Ярости через поимку 7 Смертных Грехов для Обугленного совета, ещё одно избитое в играх клише, твист который породит сюжетную дыру. В ходе этого Ярость и поймёт, что Война то невиновен, что и демоны бывают правы и враги ближе чем ты думаешь. Возвращение к лору 1-ой части. Как минимум 8 запоминающихся персонажей. Вот список: Война, Ярость, Вульгрим, Зависть, Лень, Похоть, Алчность, Чревоугодие, Гордость. [h1] Геймплей: [/h1] наконец добавлена механика спринта, 4 элементальных формы, для вертикального высокого прыжка, пикирования, прыжки, бег по воде и катание камнем по стене. Элементы акробатики присутствуют, от порталов и паркура избавились, оно и к лучшему. Всё те же приёмы, снова без блока только увороты. Кристаллы в место хилок. Торговая экономика душ как в 1-ой части. Боссы с разными мув-сетами, но одним подходом. [h1] Графика: [/h1] очень красивый визуальный ряд с качественными эффектами, что аж лагать начнёт. Качественное освещение, прорисовка волос, игра света и тени. Шейдеры воды и отражения, эффекты огня оранжево-белыми без жёлтого мыла, высокая детализация. [h1] Левел-дизайн и арт-дизайн: [/h1] тут нам предоставляют несколько больших локаций разделённые на зоны:пустоты, преисподнюю, канализация, пригород, затопленный квартал. Все они разные, но элементы интерьера только в Убежище кузницы творца, а так снова чувство пустоты по кишкообразным локациям. По повду арт-дизайна то все хорошо нарисованы: Война, Ярость, Смерть, Раздор, Вульгрим, Зависть, Лень, Похоть, Алчность, Чревоугодие, Гордость. [h1] Звук и саундтреки: [/h1] качественный звук, разделённый на музыку, эффекты и голоса и очень красивые саундтреки, на несколько голов выше 2-ой части. [h1] Анимации:[/h1] очень качественные телодвижения и жестикуляция персонажей, проработанная и добротная лицевая анимация. Сочные казни в в хорошо срежессированных кат-сценах. [h1] Камера: [/h1] удобная, ровная не вызывает никаких претензий с 3-го раз у серии получилось хорошо сделать этот аспект. [h1] Интерфейс и управление: [/h1]стильный и понятный интерфейс, управление привычное, но всё ещё не очень удобное. [h1] Локализация: [/h1] после 2-ой части на удивление качественная работа, как с переводом, так и с подбором голосов. Актёры харизматичные, как и в оригинале, демоны отыгрывают нужные черты характера исходя из имён грехов: Алчность кривляка, Вульгрим заманчивый, Зависть завистлива, Гордость высокомерна, Чревоугодие мерзкий, Лень расслабленный и ленивый и т.д. Всадник та же хорошо отыграны Ярость стервозна и саркастична, Война рассудительный. Но проблемы всё же есть: иначе переведены шутки, проблемы в одной сцене с липсинком, пара неубедительных дублей, странно переведены предметы. В целом голоса очень похожи, интонации соблюдены и в большинстве перевод хороший. [b] Из плюсов: + интересная сюжетная линия; + увлекательный геймплей: спринт, боевая система, разнообразие врагов; + графика и качественные кат-сцены; + хороший арт-дизайн + звук и лаконичные саундтреки; + камера и красиво задизайненный интерфейс; + анимации телодвижений и лицевые анимации; + хорошая русская локализация (чертовски редко бывает) Из минусов: - техническая часть: фризы жёсткие перед появление Вульгрима в точке сохранений и во-время ё*бки спецэффектами; - так себе левел-дизайн; - по-прежнему не особо удобное управление. [/b] [i] Вердикт: 7.5 из 10 хорошо, но не слишком амбициозно, как заявлялось. [/i]Рекомендую, как фанатам серии так и любителям слэшеров и соулс-лайков.

I don't really feel like this game tells you what you are doing or sets the scene at all, which seems strange from a gameplay point of view and a narrative one too. So you start the game with no idea really what's going on or what you're meant to do and, gameplay wise, how to actually do it.  The game is based around having conversations with your patients, but the conversations are near impossible to navigate. You really only get responses to very specific questions and the responses just come from trigger words and ignore how you phrase the question. So you can ask someone 'what they had for dinner' and if 'dinner' is an important topic then they will talk about it, but they won't directly answer your question. Immediately this makes conversations flow really awkwardly and really you needn't ask questions at all. As in the example I just gave you could just say 'dinner' and they would say what they were going to anyway. This disrupts any connection to the idea that you are having a  conversation or that what you type actually matters.  Edit: I forgot to add that the game really stunts you from having a conversation with people, as so many things you try to talk about are just met with a 'I don't want to talk about that' or 'I don't know about that' response. It is really jarring for trying to have a conversation.  Pretty disappointed overall. I only played for 40 minutes, so take from that what you will.

Prós +Gráficos +Trilha sonora  Contra -Cansativo -Enjoa Fácil -Sem objetivo -Sem história -Não é um jogo -Sem opções além de dirigir ao infinito -Preço alto por ser só isso  XepaGames e Cyber não recomenda de forma alguma se você gosta de um jogo! The parry trivializes every fight pretty hard, but the timer on every character was enough to keep me engaged even if most of the puzzles and enemies were dull. I'd say the biggest disappointment is that the timer on characters is never toyed with in any way (play Fallout 1 for an example of this being done well).  There's never an acceleration on people's time, dying doesn't hurt the timer much to matter, and you'll likely beat the game without anyone dying from the disease. The only reason I'm not giving this game a thumbs down is because 3/5 dungeons are pretty good, with the fire and ice ones being the standouts. Overall, its a well-made game that you'll probably enjoy, but there's not much to love about it.  Also, if any of the developers read this, please remove the ability to turn off the timers, its the most interesting part of the game and almost everything falls flat without it. I know it makes some people uncomfortable, but the timer IS the game and it made me feel certain emotions I haven't felt in a while. This might be a bit of an extreme suggestion, but I think every character's timer should be halved or be the same across the board so you have to choose who to keep alive. I never had to make a tough call because the times are so generous. Maybe new game plus or hard mode fix it, but that first playthrough didn't give a great impression on how I think I was supposed to feel.

I really didn’t want to like this game. I suppose because I’d played it briefly on the Xbox One and every time I touch a game on the new consoles I’m underwhelmed by the lack of ‘next-gen’ features and graphics. However, Wolfenstien is a very, very good FPS with a solid story, decent GFX and enforces classic FPS style gameplay. It has a neo-noir style that doesn’t plagiarize the likes of BioShock but does give me a sense that I’ve played and seen something similar before. That said, it holds its own as a unique title and stands firmly above the crowd as a respectable game.    I did not like the fact that the main character is as American as a bacon double cheese burger. Forever are the studios plugging American’s ego when it comes to war, battle and history when story boarding these games. I do enjoy the alternative universe that’s been created and it’s even quite believable for the most part, until the all American hero takes a stabbing from a Nazi only to then immediately recover. Aside from those being the main issues I had with the game, it could have done with some more weapons, a more flattering talent tree, which is unfortunately option less and an inventory system would have gone a long way to earning some extra points from me.     I’m glad I waited for this to go on sale. I’m not saying it’s a bad game, but even though I am going to play through it once or maybe twice more, it’s just not worth the full price. Either wait for it to go 50% off on steam or check G2A or GMC for a better deal. It’s been out some months now and even brand new I don’t think is deserving of the RRP. 7/10

Avventura picchiaduro molto lineare, con livelli molto ristretti, il tutto con taglio cinematografico.   lo svolgimento base del gioco: 1) filmato di inizio capitolo 2) breve dialogo via radio col boss 3) camminata verso l'unico luogo raggiungibile (perchè tutto le porte tranne una saranno chiuse ed è possibile scavalcare solo gli ostacoli che il gioco decide di farti scavalcare), con qualche collezionabile nascosto  4) qualche arrampicata a prova di stupido, dato che è agevolata dal un segnalino che vi indicherà dove saltare successivamente 5) magari un enigma basato sull'atto dell'arrampicarsi e spostare oggetti col magnetismo 6) combattimento 3) ripeti da 3 fino diverse volte fino alla fine del capitolo  ... insomma, è Uncharted 2 con pugni e calci invece delle pistole e ambientazione cyberpunk al posto di templi e zone esotiche.  Il combattimento è il punto focale del gioco, e allo stesso tempo la parte che cerca di essere profonda e originale: il tutto si basa sull'esecuzione di combo fisse, da corte e lunghe ma comunque facili da eseguire a patto di avere un certo tempismo, di cui è possibile personalizzare l'effetto di ogni colpo (che può essere guarigione, danno, incremento efficacia della mossa successiva, caricamento della barra dell'abilità speciale) tentendo conto che la stessa funzione ha un'efficacia maggiore se posta verso la fine.  La difficoltà è costituita dalla presenza o meno di altri nemici sul campo e dalla loro tipologia, in quanto alcuni possono attaccare dalla lunga distanza o essere addirittura invisibili nelle zone d'ombra. La curva di difficoltà è molto ragionevole e soddisfacente.  Le boss fight ci sono, ma non sono troppo interessanti e per giunta alcuni presentanto dei quick time event.  Completato il gioco è possibile selezionare un determinato capitolo o giocare alla modalità New Game +, che consente di giocare dall'inizio senza perdere le combo sviluppate durante la partita precedente. I collezionabili sbloccano delle immagini visionabili nella galleria. Non sono disponibili costumi alternativi.  Grafica ottima per l'epoca, possibile soprattutto grazie alla ristrettezza dei livelli.

What a great game. As a lot of the other reviews indicate - the main character, Senua, suffers from severe psychosis. She is constantly hearing voices, experiencing auditory/visual hallucinations, and undergoing consistent mental stress. The game developers do an excellent job of interweaving the psychosis aspects into the mechanics of the game. The voices will react to what you are currently experiencing. The hallucinations will make you second guess if you're looking at something correctly, and throughout the beautiful cutscenes you will see evidence of the mental strenuation that Senua has been through.   This game is a tale of devotion as Senua travels through Viking Hell to attempt to rescue her dearly lost lover. A modern day Dante's Inferno, you will find in this game that the magnificent visual and audial aspects interwoven with grandiose Viking lore crafts a version of the story that can stand on it's own. I highly recommend this game if you think you can weather the trials that Senua will need to conquer - as you will need to do so alone, in the opposition of many different facets of the true darkness a person can experience.

通关了写个评测纪念下，游戏分成两部分，通关v1时游戏时间20小时，通关v2时游戏时间66小时。  其中v2在某一关卡卡关20+小时，过了一段时间重新审题才走出死胡同。建议卡关时不要死磕，散散步，换换心情。  减去卡关时间，从通关时间来看其实两部分游戏的难度并没有显著提升，这当然与通关v1之后玩家已经进行了充分的训练有关，但我仍然认为v2的题目更加“有趣”（尽管有少量题目用到的技巧过于雷同）。  回到游戏本身，这个游戏的puzzle显然不适合所有人，因为这些谜题更像是象棋或者围棋的残局，需要Player进行大量的脑力运算，这在许多人看来是非常枯燥的。  但是如果你是热衷于这类解谜的人，如果你是一个会在吃饭、睡觉、洗澡时都思考解谜的人，那这款游戏值得你的尝试。  不要被看似汇编代码的游戏方式吓倒，游戏本身提供了详实的说明书，这些简单的指令其实和棋盘上棋子的走法规则并没什么不同，都是游戏的规则。花费一些时间仔细看一遍说明书，在遗忘时多多翻阅，这些规则很容易被你熟记。  令人惊讶的是，这款游戏确实有它的故事背景，这些背景有些藏匿在说明书里，有些在游戏当中，如果你的英文水平足够好，又能进行沉浸式的游玩，也许有幸能够体验一把在游戏过程中揭露未知的令人兴奋的游玩过程。

Crosscode es un Action RPG que bebe mucho de la fórmula Zelda, con un enorme mundo para explorar, repleto de enemigos, secretos, y mazmorras con intrincados puzzles.  Ambientado en un MMO ficticio basado en avatares con una presencia física en el mundo real (gracias a una tecnología de luz sólida), manejaremos a Lea, una Avatar con amnesia y muda, recorriendo el mundo mientras completa la quest principal del juego y resuelve dudas sobre su pasado.  El juego tiene partes bastante diferenciadas y casi siempre separadas: Combate, puzzles y plataformeo/exploración.   El combate es divertido y hace un fuerte uso de los diferentes controles (ataque a distancia, cuerpo a cuerpo, dash) y más adelante de 4 efectos elementales, forzando a estar siempre alerta y vigilando la sobrecarga del sistema (ya que usar daño elemental constantemente causa un bloqueo en el cual dejamos de poder usarlo durante un rato).  Los puzzles suelen ser bastante intricados, y aunque normalmente no es difícil de encontrar la solución (suele haber marcas en el suelo que dan pistas sobre lo que hay que hacer), ejecutarla requiere puntería con los disparos y ser rápido y preciso en los desplazamientos (disparar a un punto, correr a otro sitio y disparar a otro antes de que se agote el tiempo, etc). Son más o menos entretenidos aunque en la segunda mitad del juego abusan mucho de ellos y se vuelven bastante largos, y no siempre tienen un buen ritmo (se echan en falta más combates entre puzzle y puzzle para relajar).  La exploración/plataformeo es complicada, ya que al ser un juego cenital no se presta mucho a ello y hay confusión con las diferentes alturas, además en ocasiones para llegar a ciertos sitios se requiere recorrer bastante distancia por caminos complejos y traicioneros. Mucha de esta exploración no es necesaria para completar el juego, pero hay bastantes partes en las que sí, y no siempre queda claro el camino a seguir (aunque sí que queda claro nuestro siguiente objetivo).  El juego incorpora un sistema de crafteo en forma de mercaderes, que te venden armamento especial a cambio de ingredientes que sueltan ciertos enemigos y plantas. Estos requisitos suelen ser excesivos, y no siempre queda claro dónde encontrarlos (aunque hay una enciclopedia con los enemigos y lo que sueltan, no es muy sencillo encontrar lo que buscamos), habré comprado 4-5 piezas de esta forma en toda la partida. Afortunadamente también se ofrece equipamiento estándar que se puede adquirir con dinero, aunque se pierden efectos útiles.  Por último quiero indicar que la dificultad base del juego es ALTA, tanto en combates como en puzzles. No es completamente prohibitiva y el respawn es moderadamente laxo (salimos en la entrada de la zona, y al terminar un combate recuperamos toda la salud), pero aprovechan para hacer combates muy intensos. Se incluyen dos ajustes para reducir la dificultad de los combates y de los puzzles (reduciendo las exigencias de tiempo), así que imagino que sea más sencillo usándolos.  En resumen, un juego 2D muy recomendable y muy cuidado. A lo mejor no le gusta a todos, pero creo que merece la pena echarle un vistazo.

I’ve always felt optimization games were missing a goal. so when I saw this on a friend’s game list I knew I had to try it.   It’s an early access game so for those you usually have to take the good with the bad, but honestly even with a few complaints it’s more polished than many released games at the moment. It feels like playing a classic game of planetary annihilation without the pressure of competing with an AI that can put optimize and out micromanage you. Instead the focus is on building an engine of pure consumption. Everything can be broken down, everything will be used as some production input. Flying across the world and seeing my massive field of oil refineries churning out graphene and deuterium sparks joy. I can’t wait to actually start shooting shit into space, and mining clathrates from gas giants as I have just completed my second trip back from my first interplanetary colony.   There are a number of things I would like to see improved before release. There needs to be much more information exposure. The tutorial videos included are borderline useless and linking tooltips a la paradox games and an in-game reference would go miles towards opening up the information space. This is probably the most important change that I’d like to see.  On a related note, what bothers me most about the game is the absolutely terrible English localization. A lot of games by foreign developers have a few mistakes here and there but in this game I genuinely have a problem understanding the tutorial write ups and voice overs. It harms my ability to grasp the systems I’m trying to build. I would love to see a significant improvement in this, because I need to know if my factories may pre-house the seamy side volitation.   Aside from these few frustrations I would highly recommend this game to people who are interested in futurism and mega-engineering, people who loved Total Annihilation and its spiritual successors, people who want to feel like they are colonizing the galaxy, and people who like to relax by optimizing production lines. After sinking 35 hours into the game I finally finished it today. I am a big fan of everything Lovecraft and after playing the Call Of Cthulhu game and liking it, I craved more lovecraftian gaming experiences. This game was that - a great lovecraftian vibe and basic enough story with semi-complicated detective and combat elements. However, that is all it is. The detective work becomes stale after so many side missions that I gave up on trying to do them all fairly early on as each one had the same rinse and repeat process. Only the story missions each felt genuinely unique, but even they became stale toward the endgame. The combat is clunky, and there are only four enemy types that you ever fight, so it gets boring fast. Another problem- the ending is the most underwhelming experience of any game I've played. There's no boss fight, so there ended up being no reason for me to mass-craft ammo and bombs before the final mission and no reason to progress my combat skill tree. Each of the three final decisions end in a 30 second cutscene that doesn't really leave you satisfied no matter what you pick, because your previous decisions through the game don't effect the ending choices at all (cough, telltale, cough). All in all, this game does a great job at the vibe and lore of the source material, but unfortunately due to the devs' pressure from the publishers, it is an unfinished, unpolished game. I'd say it is only worth buying if you're really into lovecraftian horror or detective games, and only play the main missions as not to waste your time. And don't pay full price for it, wait for a sale.

I couldn't finish this game which kind of sucks since I really wanted to like it. I made it up to the plague witch and then decided I was done, not because she was super hard but because I didn't care anymore and I finished by watching the game on youtube to see what I missed. I was expecting this game to be heavily inspired by Little Nightmares and it was but not in the best way. You'll definitely receive Little Nightmares flashbacks while playing, both from the sheer numbers of gnomes and some of the puzzles. The game has real boss fights and this is really not a good thing. The throw/fire mechanic is clunky and the controls aren't the best either. Also, you make your monsters a lot less scary once you make us fight them instead of being forced to flee from them. The game's horrifying scenes are well done and satisfyingly intense but the game doesn't really generate fear very well. The bosses are all pretty easy too.  The game keeps going back and forth between wanting to terrify you and wanting you to appreciate the beauty and wonder of the magical world. It does an OK job at the former and it badly fails at the latter. The landscapes are consistently beautiful or at least, they are very impressive when they want to be. Unfortunately some of the 'stages' are not impressive by design. These areas especially the swamp and the village are intended to be mostly about the banality and gruesomeness of ordinary death so they don't take advantage of the amazing art work delivered at other times. The last level is amazingly put together, the artwork is like something out of Dark Souls. The artwork I saw during the let's play of the final level was so good that I considered going back and finishing the game.  The game keeps you on a very tight leash and there's basically no exploration at all. You just wander from scene to scene. The story is not very good. It feels unfocused and we don't really find out any connection between the big bad and our quest until the very end. The story is at its best when dealing with the trolls. When it tackles other concepts and monsters, it loses its footing. The story is chalk full of DEUS EX escapes which get frustrating after a while. If you liked Little Nightmares, I won't say don't buy this but maybe wait for a sale.  Spoilers: The troll scenes are probably the best parts of the game. The rest is kind of hit and miss. The Huldre (They call her a Skogra) fight is cool as is the 'lake fiddler chase.' The Pesta is annoying but I give the game prompts for her visuals. If you look carefully, you can see her watching you from the distance long before she shows up to fight you. My favorite parts of the story are the early parts with the trolls but the game is actually pretty solid as long as we're hiding or running from a colossal monster. The Mountain King himself, the main villain, has really no connection to the kids. So when you actually fight him, there isn't much invested in the fight, especially since at that point you're not sure if you can still get Lillimore back. The Huldre boss and the Swamp witch were both interesting because they made me wonder if maybe I'd made a mistake in killing the Huldre and letting the baby die and was now on the way to the bad ending. I did some research and there is only one ending. You can't save the baby and if you show Huldre mercy, she just kills you. So everything the game tries to do to make you feel guilty is just annoying. The Huldre being the one that Tuva calls you out for crossing the line on really feels strange. She's not a sympathetic monster. We know from her backstory that she kills people without hesitation or remorse. She's more human looking than most of the other monsters and more attractive than the trolls but that's about it.  It just feels weird that the game tries to make you feel guilty for killing her.

Premetto che alla scrittura ho completato il gioco con il completamento dei trofei:  Strada è un gioco estremamente coinvolgente, uno di quei giochi in cui il tempo passa senza che tu te ne accorga, mentre la tua mente ragiona vieni cullato dalle note che mano a mano che risolvi il puzzle vengono eseguite ad ogni tua azione, e stonando invece ad ogni tuo errore. Un gioco adatto anche ai più piccoli, utile magari per introdurli nel mondo della logica visiva, oltre che strumento di allenamento per i più grandi nella stessa.  Il gioco in se non è molto difficile da capire, anzi, il tutorial iniziale è molto intuitivo e la meccanica di fondo è anche molto originale.  Alle lunghe non ti senti annoiato, complice anche il fatto che ad ogni quadro le musiche cambiano, intonando nuove note ogni volta che compi una azione, mentre la difficoltà fra gli stage aumenta con l'incremento del numero di righe e colonne in cui disporre le linee e i differenti colori che le stesse possono prendere.   Pro:   + Grafica colorata e molto curata, con un bellissimo sincronismo fra azione compiuta e melodia   + Gamplay intuitivo ma interessante, con una meccanica originale e che alle lunghe non annoia   + Adatto anche ai più piccoli; utile come esercizio per la logica (consiglio se avete figli/fratelli/nipoti/etc. dai 13 anni in su di proporgli questo gioco anche come sfida, ma prima ancora che come metodo per affinare la logica)  Sinceramente non trovo contro da assegnare al gioco, è un puzzle game che rispecchia le aspettative, propone un gamplay e lo tiene acceso con l'aumentare delle sfide; unica cosa che gli si potrebbe rimproverare è che dal 5° quadro in poi la difficoltà ricomincia per poi riaumentare fino al quadro finale, ma dato che in realtà il cambio è un cambio generale di tema e stile musicale, non lo ritengo un difetto, quanto una interessante scelta di gamedesign.  Voto 10/10, consigliatissimo per tutti coloro che vogliono un gioco rilassante ma comunque impegnativo

This is a fantastic installment of the Total War franchise. Before playing this game, the only version I played was Empires: Total War, which I thoroughly enjoyed. I am also an avid warhammer fan, and I can attest that this game pleased both sides of my inner fanboy. The graphics can be very immersive, even on low graphics quality. The game brings very unique units and encourages an advanced level of tactical thinking while holding true to the 'rock<paper<scissors' mechanic total war has always had. In my opinion, it is a perfect mesh of a real time strategy game and a turn based strategy game. The Campaign is made just right in terms of teaching you how to play the game while at the same time captivating your interest and catering to your style of play. Do you like playing a more balanced, diplomatic approach? The Empire is perfect for you, or perhaps even Bretonnia.   Do you prefer ravaging the countryside and grinding your enemies to dust? Chaos and Greenskins all the way. Feeling like smashing someone's head in with an axe or hammer while holding a mug of ale? Dwarves! And let us not forget the Vampire Counts and Woodelves, and the distinct feels we all remember from Warhammer Fantasy/Age of Sigmar. The game does very well in making you feel invested in your faction, but not forcing you to do so if you just want to play the game.   All in all, I'd rate this game an 8.8/10, with the only thing keeping it from receiving a perfect score being how they have done their DLC. Most people I'm sure bought or will buy the game to play Chaos, but if you want to play the campaign with them you need to buy their DLC. Same with the woodelves, Bretonnia, etc. What I have discovered though, at least with my copy, is now that I own it I get some of their DLC for free when I would otherwise have to pay for it (if it was released after I purchased the game.)  All in all, if you aren't bothered with paying for DLC they should have included in the base game, then you will still enjoy this game.

Awful combat. This game makes the common mistakes of having little to no hitstun, no stagger, no knockback, and no knockdown mechanics. Because of this, combat devolves into a spammy flurried mess of continuously trading blows and repeatedly parrying poorly telegraphed attacks with all too brief startups. Alternatively you can take the safer but slower method of sneaking in one hit at a time and running away. And with so much of the game consisting of fighting numerous enemies in the open fields or the required combat encounters in the dungeons, the game becomes a tedious slog. Add to that the lack of checkpoints outside of loading junctions and the extreme scarcity of unlockable shortcuts, you’re often left to trudge through long sets of combat rooms if you fail to complete a dungeon in one go without dying.

L'édition originale en terme d'esthétique était un jeu sympa. L'édition définitive est un jeu vraiment bof. Des graphismes pas franchement améliorés (voire regréssifs) et ce qui aurait pu être une bonne idée se tranforme en catastrophe. Comme on le sait bien, la Chine est un pays peuplé, les gens dans la rue grouillent par milliers jusqu'à n'en plus voir le sol. Alors le fait d'avoir rajouté des PNJ dans les rues est visuellement plus agréable, mais les dévoloppeurs ont oublié que les rues du jeu n'ont pas été conçues pour tant d'entités. Alors parcourir une rue un peu étroite devient carrément infernal, surtout lors des phases de courses poursuites, où on se cogne contre une dizaine de passants en parcourant à peine dix mètres. Cela fait une transition sur le deuxième aspect du jeu.  En terme de gameplay, l'édition originale était un GTA like plutôt bof, l'édition définitive est un jeu presque naze. Mais commençons par les qualités. le traffic routier est vraiment bien fichu, avec une circulation plutôt réaliste et une conduite de véhicule crédible (sauf pour la physique des collisions, mais c'est un jeu vidéo, c'est normal !). L'environnement se voit ajouter des éléments de décor destructibles supplémentaires, alors les combats sont vraiment impressionnants par moments (en plus des gestuelles des personnages qui sont vraiment fidèles à l'esprit des films de kung fu old school). Les combats, tiens, parlons en. le système de combat, pour avoir mal vieilli, est beugué et vraiment frustrant. On se retrouve souvent en position Game Over même au tout début du jeu après s'être fait massacrer par trois malheureux ennemis de base, car la difficulté n'est pas équilibrée ! De plus, les mécaniques du jeu ont, comme dit plus haut, assez mal vieilli : le personnage n'arrivera pas à parer la moitié des coups d'un adversaire, car la réactivité du jeu quand on appuie sur les touches est affreusement lente, en plus de l'absence totale de logique dans l'alternance attaque/défense. D'ailleurs, il faut vraiment bourriner pour vaincre un ennemi, alors que notre personnage tombera parterre après une dizaine de malheureux coups qui aspirent littéralement une grosse partie de la barre de vie chacun. Ainsi on se retrouve très vite frustré de perdre dans des phases où il n'est pas censé y avoir du challenge ; quand on sort d'une partie d'un Batman récent, où les combats sont nerveux et rythmés, et qu'on se retrouve sur ce jeu, c'est assez énervant quand ce n'est pas ennuyeux/répétitif, visuellement et techniquement.  Malgré tout, Sleeping Dogs est un jeu interessant au niveau de l'histoire. On reprend tous les codes d'un film de Kung fu des années 70 et on en fait un GTA like. Incarner un flic infiltré fournit un double jeu interessant au niveau de l'histoire. l'univers graphique malgré ses nombreux défauts transporte le joueur dans un Hong Kong authentique à l'ambiance franchement bien réussie. En fin de compte, ce jeu open world est un projet ambitieux, mais il fait (selon moi) un flop. Le gameplay a mal vieilli, je ne le dirai jamais assez - j'ai oublié de citer des défauts comme la caméra à la troisième personne complétement folle, surtout en véhicule, et un manque de réactivité global dans le déplacement qui se veut plus dynamique, par exemple en parcours. Et c'est bien ce que je dis, le jeu original n'est pas top, mais l'édition définitive qui était censée redonner un second souffle au jeu ne l'a fait en rien, même pas en apparence. C'est décevant.

Cyberpunk 2077. It's fine.  It feels a bit like some of the shiny chrome in the game. You've bought it, and it looks pretty, but does it actually enhance your life? Or is it just kind of...there. Sometimes it's a good time, sometimes your body rejects it and you need to take some drugs to make it feel worthwhile.  Storywise, yeah, it's pretty good. And it's very beautiful. But the whole thing just feels kind of hollow. You're barraged with calls from fixers providing meaningless side quests or offering vehicles to purchase every time you enter a new area, but the driving isn't great and you get a few free vehicles anyway, and the sidequests feel a bit weird when the game is pushing you along the main quest with a sense of urgency. Guns and ammo are thrown at you at every available opportunity and the levelling up menu system is so enormous and sprawling it's much like the city itself - interesting to look at for a while but ultimately a bit meaningless?  There's some real good in here, but the game wouldn't suffer at all if you cut about 60% of the content. If you can get it on sale and you like shiny things, you probably won't regret it.

Ghostrunner est un bijou que je conseille à n'importe quel joueur tenté par les défis.  Niveau technique, Ghostrunner est bien optimisée. 60fps constant en élevé avec la configuration recommandé est un atout dans le cadre d'une expérience nerveuse et vive. La qualité graphique vaut son pesant d'or, même si les décors ne sont pas très variés.  Le gameplay mérite que je développe son cas. Nerveux et retord, Ghostrunner confronte le joueur à des combats pourvus d'une qualité exceptionnelle. Ce jeu est l'un des rares Die & Retry qui ne m'ont jamais frustré et qui, au contraire, rendent le corps plutôt addictif. La difficulté n'a jamais été, de bout en bout, un vecteur de ragequit. Au contraire, c'est la nervosité des rixes qui laissent le joueur captivé.  comme un DOOM Eternal ou un Cuphead, le jeu vous encourage à persévérer. Vous tuez l'ennemi et en un coup, tout comme il vous tue en un coup. Le level design est un vecteur de gameplay émergent : à vous de trouver la façon qui vous convient le mieux de battre les gardes. Car c'est dans la vulnérabilité que l'on dévoile sa rage de vaincre. Le jeu n'est jamais frustrant, et ce sont les échecs à répétitions qui rendent, au contraire, le tout addictif. La difficulté, la persévérance transporte en fait le joueur dans une patience frénétique (ou une frénésie patiente ?) qui le mènera à la victoire.  Notons l'importance de la bande son, qui fait partie intégrante du gameplay, dans la mesure où elle instaure une ambiance qui sert le combat : elle pose l'ambiance et le rythme malgré elle. Le genre cyperpunk est à son apogée.  L'un des rares défauts : les phases de bossfight sont RELATIVEMENT faciles. Autre défaut, les phases d'énigmes sont frustrantes, lorsqu'apposées au phases de combat en arène, car elles ralentissent inutilement le rythme d'un jeu dont les phases de parkour et d'exploration font déjà l'affaire. Non pas que ces énigmes soient difficiles, mais juste énervantes dans la mesure où le joueur est sans cesse confronté à l'action. Elles ne sont donc pas nécessaires, puisque la disposition des arènes et des ennemis est déjà une énigme en soi : en d'autres termes, le joueur voit déjà ses capacités à rude épreuve au coeur du combat, demandant planification, stratégie, réflexes et improvisation (dans cet ordre).  Dans tous les cas, Ghostrunner est un défi que je conseille à tout joueur assoiffé de défi : easy to learn, hard to master, il représente une aventure riche en défi et riche de ses qualités techniques et artistiques qui n'ont pas à rougir des triple A récents.

我不知道为什么开发那么执着于无尽模式现有的存档机制，一次爆炸全部白给。 难道不可以设计成不同难度、不同的机制吗？比如简单和普通可以每次到达车站之后在车站存档，困难或者地狱之类的不能存档。 或者开发两种游戏模式，一种是不能存档的，一种是可以存档的。 重点是：玩家想要选择。 跟朋友联机玩了半天，从一开始手忙脚乱到渐渐把握了技巧开始享受到游戏的乐趣，感受到了快乐，结果突然一次意外车头爆炸——在我们以为自己勾选了存档就可以从上一个车站继续的时候却发现还是从0米开始，那一瞬间真的心态爆炸了。这个游戏不是那种一把一两分钟跑酷游戏，死了重来也不会怎么样；每一次都要花很多时间的玩的游戏突然一下从0开始，而且还毫无选择，这种感觉我个人是不太能接受的。 有的玩家可能就喜欢这种真实粗犷的感觉，但是肯定也有人不喜欢。希望在今后的更新里，至少能让玩家去选择自己喜欢的模式吧。

I haven't played the newly released 4th episode, but I thought I recommend the game nonetheless, in the same vein the not-recommended reviewers don't...)  Edit:  Finally finished the game. It's good. Some parts amazing, others not great. The pacing could be better. Otoh, it's very much supposed to be slow paced, and I get why, but for me - I really wanted to finish it up and it felt like it dragged on. The early episodes felt a bit stronger and tighter story wise.  The highlights were the musical parts specifically, and the art, visuals, soundscape and music more generally. The story and dialogues were good, but tied to the pacing - I personally wouldn't have minded a tighter and shorter story. Some later parts could have been cut altogether since the game feels a bit disjointed and moving from place to place and character to character, which is fine and appropriate, but also means they're not crucial to the overall story arch.  Overall a very good, atmospheric point&click adventure/visual/auditory story that's easily recommended to those who like these games. Not recommended to those who may lack patience or aren't into... lets call it - 'slow-paced, atmospheric/artistic experiences with minor gameplay aspects' type of games.

Despite the fact that you pilot a spaceship in this game, Out There features no combat, opting instead for a CYOA style gameplay with events and resource management that's limited to upgrades and survival.  I found the art and soundtrack to be very nice, but the gameplay is generally shallow and heavily reliant on RNG so I don't really see a reason to play it three more times just for some extra dialogue and a different ending.  As an example, you have to probe gas giants for fuel, in order to accomplish this you must first randomly find a system with gas giants, then you must spend some fuel and oxygen to get to the planet in question and, finally, select how much fuel you want to spend while probing, which determines how much fuel you can get, but investing more fuel also increases the chances of your probe sustaining damage or breaking. This is by far the most common thing you do in this game and it's basically spending a bunch of resources in hopes of getting some more of the same resources while making a positive return on investment you can then use in order to get to the next star system and repeat the process all over again. The only thing you can do to affect this loop is buy an upgrade that reduces the risk of resource extraction by decreasing resource costs. Overall, I don't think there's anything outright wrong with Out There, it's just kind of boring because it plays like a flowchart.

[h1]HİKAYE[/h1] Sıradan bir demircinin sıradan bir oğlu olarak oyuna başlıyoruz. Sabah kahvaltımızı yapıyoruz, babamızın istediği şeyleri yapıyoruz, arkadaşlarla kralı aşağılayan adamın yeni boyanmış beyaz evinin duvarlarına b*k atıyoruz. Kavga ediyoruz, akşam olunca handa takılıyoruz, kız arkadaşımızla takılıyoruz. Her şey normal, sıradan bir insan yaşamı.  Babamız Sir Radzig Kobyla için bir kılıç sözü vermiştir ve son aşamalarını tamamlamak için Henry'den yani bizden yardım ister. Henry de yardım eder ve kılıcı bitirirler. Kobyla kılıcı almak için geldiğinde önce bir test eder, sonra Henry'nin de kılıç işlerine meraklı olduğunu fark eder ve denemek isteyip istemediğini sorar. Henry önce çekinse de ardından dener ama başarısız olur.  Kobyla gider ve kılıcın son 1-2 ayrıntısını tamamlamak üzere işe koyuluruz ancak uzaktan bir ses duyulur. O yöne bakınca görürüz ki kocaman bir ordu köyümüze saldırıyor. Herkes panikle kaleye doğru kaçmaya başlar ancak Henry'nin annesi kaleye biraz uzaktır ve babası da ona yardım etmek için o yöne doğru koşar. Babası annesine yetiştiğinde birkaç düşman askeri öldürür ama en sonununda atlı bir kel babasını öldürür, ardından annesini de diğer çok fazla kılıç darbesiyle öldürür. Bunların hepsi de Henry'nin gözünün önünde yaşanır, Henry de kaleye doğru kaçmaya çalışır ancak yetişemez ve kalenin yanındaki patikadan at ile Talmberg'e kaçar.  Hikaye böyle başlıyor bence etkileyici bir başlangıçtı. Hikaye anlatımı da oyun boyunca gayet başarılıydı. Hatta ara sahneler bağımsız bir geliştiriciye göre çok iyi hazırlanmış. Genel olarak bu kısımdan memnun olarak ayrıldım oyunun başından ama oyunun sonu sanki yarım kalmış gibi hissettim.  Oyun bir RPG oyunu aynı zamanda ve bu kısımlar da iyi yapılmış. Görevin gidişatına istediğimiz gibi yön verebiliyoruz. Henry'nin kişiliği de iyi aktarılmış. Hep ''iyi hristiyan'' kafasında ilerliyor. Bu ilerleyiş diyaloglarda sık sık karşımıza çıkıyor.  [h1]OYNANIŞ[/h1] Dediğim gibi biz sıradan bir demircinin sıradan bir oğluyuz. Orta çağ temalı bir oyun ama fantezili değil. Yani sihirli, büyülü şeyler yok. Tamamen gerçekçilik esas alınmış.  Oyun zor bunu baştan söyleyeyim. Teke-tek savaşlar bile dakikalarınızı alabiliyor. Hamle zamanlamasını, savunma anını iyi hesaplamak gerekiyor. Hele bir değil de iki düşman gelirse daha da zorlayıcı oluyor. Ordu halinde savaştığımız yerler de oluyor, buralar daha basit çünkü bu bölümlerde de yapay zeka sapıtıyor. Genel olarak oyundaki yapay zeka çok kötü değil ama ordu halinde savaştığımız bölümlerde çok kötü.  Okçuluk da yapabiliyoruz ama nişangah yok ve okçuluğa ilk başladığımız zamanlarda Henry'nin eli çok titriyor ve dayanıklılığı hızlı azalıyor. Bu da hem nişan almayı daha da zorlaştırıyor hem de nişan alma süresini kısaltıyor. Vuruş hissi iyiydi ama, kılıçla kılıç veya kılıç zırhla çarpıştığında çıkan kıvılcımlar da o hissi kuvvetlendirdi.  Teçhizat sağlığına dikkat etmemiz gerekiyor, Henry'nin temizliğine dikkat etmemiz gerekiyor. Açlığımıza, uyku düzenimize dikkat etmemiz gerekiyor. Eğer Henry yeteri kadar uyumazsa, yolda giderken gözleri kapanabiliyor. Uzun süre yemek yemezse düşüp bayılabiliyor. Temiz olmazsa konuşmasına yansıyor. Ayrıca yiyecekler zamanla çürüyor, çürük bir şey yerse de iyi etkilemiyor. Ancak bir yetenek Henry'nin çürük yemek yemesini sağlıyor. Oyunu sadece uyuyarak yada görevleri yaptıkça kaydedebiliyoruz bir de ''Kayıt İksiri'' var. Bunu içerek kaydedebiliyoruz. Bu iksirleri tüccarlardan alabiliyoruz ama ucuz değiller. Bu sistem bence çok saçma, istediğimiz zaman istediğimiz yerde kaydedebilmemiz lazım. Envanterin de bir ağırlık kapasitesi var eğer bunu aşarsanız hızlı koşamazsınız ve zıplayamazsınız. Sarhoş da olabiliyorsunuz. Normal olarak başınız dönüyor. Bir de at var. Kontrolleri genel olarak rahat ama bazen çalılara takılıyor ve çok sinir bozuyor. Ayrıca atın da kendi depolama alanı var, buraya sizin üstünüzdeki fazlalıkları atabilirsiniz. Ata zırh, nal, gözlük vb. şeyler de takabilirsiniz. At üstünden de savaşabilirsiniz ve okçuluk yapabilirsiniz.  Ufak çaplı bir suç işlediğinizde; izinsiz yerlere girmek, kavga çıkarmak, hırsızlık yapmak gibi para cezası yiyorsunuz eğer paranız yoksa hapse gidiyorsunuz, tabi eğer konuşma yeteneklerinizi kullanıp muhafızı kandırırsanız hiçbir şey olmuyor. Ancak cinayet gibi büyük bir suç işleyip yakalanırsanız doğruca hapse giriyorsunuz.  Son olarak açık dünyadan bahsedeyim. Büyük bir haritası var, ve bence dünya yaşadığını hissetiriyor. Sabahları insanların kalkıp elini yüzünü yıkaması, kendi aralarında sohbetler etmesi, bir cinayet, kavga veya hırsızlık gördüklerinde hemen muhafızlara haber vermeleri, turnuva alanında toplanmaları açık dünyanın yaşadığını hissini verdi bana.  [h1]GRAFİKLER[/h1] Grafikleri bence hala çok iyi. Animasyonları da iyi. Karakterlerin mimikleri falan gayet başarılıydı. Hatta alkollüyken bence grafikler daha güzel oluyor.  [h1]GÖREVLER[/h1] Oyunun başlarında görevler bence çok iyiydi, farklıydı ve farklı duygular yaşaatıyordu. Ancak sona yaklaştığımız kısımlarda birbirini tekrar etmeye başladılar. Yaptığımız tek şey bir lordun ayak işleri olmaya başladı. Neyse ki son görev iyiydi de oyunu iyi bitirdim.  Bol bol yan görev var hepsini yaparsanız belki 100 saati bile geçersiniz ama yan görevlerin çoğu iyi değil. Bir de etkinlikler var; avcılık, at yarışı, zar, turnuva gibi.  [h1]BUG VE OPTİMİZASYON[/h1] Oyunda çeşitli buglar var; görünmez kapı, sizi göremeyen düşman gibi gibi... Ama oyunun oynanmasını engelleyen bir bug görmedim.  Optimizasyonu ise pek iyi değil. Droplar ara sıra başıma geldi.  [h1]SESLENDİRME VE MÜZİK[/h1] Seslendirmeleri gayet başarılıydı, sesler kaliteli çıktı hep.  Müzik kısmına ise pek dikkat etmedim, sadece ben oynarken arkadaki ses gibiydi. Kötü demiyorum ama akılda kalıcı değiller.  [h1]NOT[/h1] DLClerin çoğu çok kötü ayrıca satın almaya değmez. what can i say, the start to this game was awesome.  as i kept on playing i enjoyed the mechanics a lot!  as i reached the two hour mark i started to realize that  every dialogue option was almost forcing me to be some radical communist ideologue. the freedom in most dialogue options when it comes to side characters  and even some main ones would only let me be an upstanding communist.  in a game that boast about freedom in choice,  what if i wanted to be an evil fascist or a more neutral party. at some point it started feeling like some sort of existential college  student trying to convince me of whats right and whats wrong. honestly there's a lack of nuance and it eventually starts to become  some spewing drivel about how taxes are wrong and history sucks. im not doing justice in my description, but im sure its donned on some who have played. this starts to feel like some sort of propaganda piece, more so than a dialogue driven rpg where one can make storied choices.  i understand 2 hours is not a whole lot for an rpg, but it came off so abrasive in just those 2 hours. im not one to hate something i disagree with but have  some panache about it. there are a lot of different choices to be had now, dont get me wrong. but a lot of the interactions and characters force you down a very narrow path of dialogue a lot of time.  for instance there are many points where lets say theres someone working outside and you are thrown a critique about how unions are the only way and working to get paid and not getting paid before work is wrong.  how capitalism is bad and taxes are pointless. what im trying to say is there is an unreasonable amount of personal politics in this game and a  lack of choice to reasonably disassociate yourself from them, so you feel like your character is already defined rather then you are making your own  character and choices.   there is a massive lack of nuance, and it comes across like a soapbox rather then a character you build up from amnesia. no your character is a pro union communist who hates capitalism and bashes the FASH! now i dont care whoever is right or wrong. but what id care about is the lack of the mass effect, being i cant chose to be a paragon or renegade, in most options so far. when the game isnt preaching some radical ideological view, its absolutely  amazing.  it is rather sad its so politically driven. and im writing this as a warning to those who dislike force fed politics in their  past time hobbies. you have been warned.  p.s. this is more of a point and click adventure with rpg mechanics. and the leveling progression is very slow. there are few wonky fail states, like turning on lights and other secrets. there not a whole lot of action (there are some high points though and Didn't post a serious review in years but this game really blew me away. From start to finish the progression was just perfect, every weapon upgrade, every mask shard, every charm, they felt earned and actually useful and you get them at the perfect time.   It has some amazing level design with enemy variation and no room almost felt like it was there for nothing. There was always something to find almost, worthy of exploration. I liked the variation in areas in general, their overall look and feel.  Speaking of looks, I really like the art style and how well the animations were done. Of course, the music adds a lot to it and it's definitely amazing as well.  Despite the fast paced boss fights and really tough platforming, the game still has moments where you can just relax and look at a lake with a buddy or sit on a bench and watch as it rains. These calm moments are very needed and add to the overall feel.  Another great thing is that the world speaks for itself, although there are not many characters you actually talk with, you can see the story unfold from exploring all the different places.  My only complaints are that some boss fights weren't too fun and memorable (what I consider fun fights are for example Grimm and Soul Master, lame ones are Uumuu or Flukemarm) and that the platforming in some areas just wasn't fun because it felt a bit stiff compared to games like Celeste.  Overall, amazing game, I highly recommend it, it's an 11/10.

Alan Wake c'était bien grace à son histoire assez palpitante, et son ambiance assez stressante.  Les graphismes était bon et le gameplay un peu basique (même s'il se suffisait plutôt durant le premier jeu).  Dès les deux dlc (the signal et the writer), je sentais déjà que le charme du jeu commençait à s'estomper. The Signal nous offrait une version alan wake sans scénar, ce qui déjà rendait le gameplay un peu plus pénible, même si l'ambiance marchait toujours plus ou moins. Heureusement The Writer est revenu hausser la barre avec ses idées un peu innovante et un scénar pas forcement beaucoup plus étoffé, mais qui ne laissait pas beaucoup de répis à la reflexion.  Je sortais donc de Alan Wake plutôt satisfait, et décidait de me faire le spin-off, bien qu'assez décrié.  Je m'attendais pas à grand chose, mais quand même: déception. Pour moi les seules bons points du jeu sont ses graphismes plutôt jolie, et ses cinématiques avec acteurs réels (il me semble en tout cas, sinon c'est mega bien foutue).  Pour le reste... Déjà changer d'ambiance pourquoi pas, j'ai trouvé ça même la transition assez réussis au début: les décors sont beau, le coté désertique est sympa, mais bien vite un problème se pointe. Qu'est ce que ce jeu est simple.  Et du coup, qui dit facilité, dit jamais aucun stress. Et puis mettre des mitraillettes dans alan wake... mon dieu.  Malheureusement l'histoire n'aide pas.  Déjà qu'est ce que c'est ce bordel avec spring night?  Alors au début on pense que c'est un épisode, écrit par Alan Wake, mais en faite visiblement c'est un sorte de vie réel, mais y'a quand même une voix off, et une conclusion. Mais du coup si c'est un épisode, quand alan wake a pu l'écrire? N'est il toujours pas dans les limbes? Et Night Spring qui est une série qu'on voyait dans Alan Wake parle déjà de possédé? Comment Alan Wake peut être un personnage principal de Night Spring? Mais rien qu'en enlevant ce (mauvais) statut de base, l'histoire est vraiment mauvaise. Autant le jour perpétuelle ça peut donner de bonne chose au cinéma ou en série, mais alors en jeu vidéo ça me parait compliqué (quelqu'un m'a parlé de Majora's Mask, mais n'y ayant pas joué...). Parce qu'on se fait quand même bien chier de coté là... enfin du coté du jeu aussi. Rajoutons à ça une fin naze, un méchant qu'on affronte jamais, et aucun bon personnage, et on obtient un scénario ultra bas de gamme, qui contraste pas mal avec celui de Alan Wake, qui a défaut d'être un chef d'oeuvre, resté ultra efficace et prenant.  En bref, un jeu qui est pas loin d'être l'antithèse de Alan Wake. Et c'est triste. Je pourrais avoir peur pour la suite, mais The Writer m'a un peu rassuré sur Alan Wake 2. Mais s'il vous plait Remedy, bossez votre Alan Wake 2, même si on doit encore attendre 5 ans de dévellopement, bossez le, car ce genre de spin off baclé, ça ne servira qu'à tuer une licence, qui partait diablement bien.

TL;DR: on the merits as a game, this sucks.  It's an RPG maker game with little effort put into the gameplay.  The art is nice and the story is meh.  Maybe pick it up if you're into the whole goo TF / assimilation thing, but otherwise, don't bother.  Note: the below review is for the base version of the game.  There has since been released a 'remaster' named 'Changed-special,' which you can download in the utilities section of your library if you own it.  The new version of the game fixes most of the issues presented in this review, if only by removing the elements which cause the underlying systems to become problematic.  Movement is still not responsive or good for precision but the AI has been reworked so most puzzles with the exception of one (the dragon puzzle) no longer rely on RNG elements, many art assets have been redone for better readability, and there's overall more polish to the game.  The writing is more clear and there are more elements to lead the player to conclusions the game wants them to get to.  Unless you're into the whole fetish thing this game has, this would not even be worth playing if it was free.  The game runs on a practically unmodified version of RPG maker so it automatically loses points for that alone, but aside from the art and music, the entire rest of the game is just poorly made and poorly coded.  The environment design is incredibly confusing and painful to work with when you require very precisely timed and accurate movement and there's a wall someplace there clearly doesn't look like there is, and the player controller is unresponsive and awful, as is the case with all RPG maker games.  I respect the fact that they tried to put in so many game aspects into an RPG maker thing but they did not at all improve the systems in place in creating that game and we're left with a painful experience that isn't worth the story it's written for.  I should also mention many of the puzzle aspects rely on RNG to function, which is an immense problem and only serves to make the game seem unfair and inconsistent.  Avoid unless you want a rage game or are really into latex furries.

This has been on my wishlist for a short while, and was gifted to me as a raffle prize from a wonderful community.    What can I say about this game that isn't already obviouse?  It's a 16-bit esque side-scrolling adventure game.  Need I say more?  Well.....I kinda have to, because just that alone doesn't do the game justice at all.  It's 100% fucking amazing!  Time to break it down. (scale 1-5)  Gameplay - 5:  Simply put, this game is FUN FUN FUN FUN FUN!  Pinkie Pie herself wouldn't be able to put it down (yes, I will use pony references sometimes, abiet, not often).  This game combines the speed of Sonic the Hedgehog, the enemy trouncing of SMB (defeating them by landing on their heads mechanic), and normal brawling attacks of any beat-em-up out there.  Not big on any kind of special moves, but the charge dash feature allows for wall-to-wall climbing.  The action is fast-paced and never seems dull.  You will find familiar power-ups akin to Sonic.  Most of this game borrows mechanics heavily from the Sonic universe, including air bubbles and shields, but that's not a bad thing here.  The life meter is a huge welcome over one-hit kills or 1 ring level rushing.  There's also at least one other character you can select from in the very beginning of the game (as of this writing, that's all I can confirm right now) with the possibility of other playable characters, and, from the looks of it, might play a little differently.  I will update this review to reflect on that when I use at least the other initial selectable character.  Controls - 4.75: The controls are absolutely perfect and customizable, however, the .25 knock is only because the keyboard controls might put some people off.  In this day and age, side-scrollers DEMAND controllers, but the keyboard does work fairly well.  Best with a controller, but the only small gripe I have is you need to go to the options menu in order to activate controller controls (at least, I had to do that before my 360 wired gamepad would work).  Other than that, the controls are just about as flawless as you can get from a game like this.  Graphics - 5: Now, I know a 16 bit era esque game isn't going to look the best compared to other games, but it DOESN'T NEED TO HAVE ALL THE FLASH OF TODAY'S GAMES TO LOOK FANTASTIC!  The graphics do an amazing job with the environment details and hazards abound.  The character models move fluidly and are very well designed.  The hit detection is spot-on perfect, so you never feel like you missed a hit on an enemy as the hit boxes are exactly where they need to be put.  Colors spewed across the levels are vibrant and bright where they need to be, and dark and gloomy in the undergound areas without feeling like it's too dark to see any action.    Sound - 4: This may seem like a slight to steep hit, but let me explain a few things before you rant off about this score.  The music is simply amazing and each level will have you nearly moving to the beat of the music while you blaze through the level.  HOWEVER, the voice acting seems a bit forced.  I will say the voices do fit the characters very well, but sometimes, the acting itself feels a little forced.  Sound dapeners and effects, such as reverbs would have worked.  The clean microphone recordings are great and all, but when it calls for maybe a bit of gritty work, it sounds too clean at points.  There are a few times when you might find the voices a bit robotic and maybe a bit monotone, but don't let this stop you.  The voice work is good, just needs a bit more work.  This is the only bite I will take from all this.  The bottom line: 4.85: Fans of side-scrollers will find tons to love about this game.  Small nuances aside, I had to pull myself away from the action to write this review.  This was BEGGING to be written as soon as possible.  I put Freedom Planet up there with Super Mario Bros., Sonic the Hedgehot (Genesis era, because the newer Sonics are killing the mascot), and Shantae (can't get enough BUTT WIGGLES and hair-whipping action).  All in all, there's lots to be loved here.  The challenge never feels extremely difficult, but not a walk in the park either.  Collectables strewn across each level and challenging boss battles make this game appealing to just about anyone looking for a good trip back down memory lane or an introduction of what Sonic could have continued becoming.  If a sequel ever does come out (not sure how the story ends as of this writing, so not sure if it's open ended for one), I'd definitely like to see more and any welcomed improvements.

Un juego de sigilo e infiltración de libro, en el que el enfrentamiento directo es suicida.  El diseño de niveles me resultó muy interesante, con niveles considerablemente grandes, mucha verticalidad, y un buen puñado de aproximaciones y rutas diferentes.  La dificultad es un poco inestable, con partes muy sencillas y otras considerablemente más complicadas de superar. En general es difícil y recomiendo utilizar el guardado de partidas para evitar tener que repetir demasiadas cosas, ya que los guardados automáticos son muy escasos.  Como es costumbre, hay premios por explorar los mapas, por superarlos sin ser vistos, etc., pero la verdad que no me pegaba que un goblin con pinta de asesino fuese a ser misericordioso con esos apestosos humanos...  La historia también me pareció bastante conseguida, inicialmente parecía que iba a ser de lo más típica y un par de giros la convierten en algo que te deja con ganas de continuar a ver qué pasa.  Como pegas, la segunda mitad del juego utiliza los mismos niveles de la primera, pero recorridos al revés, y el juego quizás enseña las habilidades demasiado deprisa, sin añadir apenas nuevos movimientos o habilidades a partir de la 2ª-3ª misión.  En resumen, un juego de sigilo considerablemente largo que cumple lo que promete, y que realmente requiere sigilo para ser superado.

I had the privilege of playing through the Prologue before its official release date. I had only minor gripes with the game and will absolutely be playing the full game on it’s release.  The story is set in a futuristic Indonesia and the story starts with a rather confronting choice our character has to make before you take control of him. It gives you only a taste of what the story is with our character Setyo and I’m looking forward to finding out more. Love the graphics. The art has the retro pixel feel but with a nuanced modern touch. Really quite beautifully done. I’ve played a side scroller game before which felt super limited, however this one offers more depth. It’s not just left to right. There is more to the world and I appreciated that.  I couldn’t figure out of if the text hadn’t received a proper read through or if it was imitating the way that certain cultures speak in English? But I stumbled over reading some of the lines. Not the end of the world, but still something I noticed. My biggest gripe was that I couldn’t choose to save. Or I couldn’t find a way to. I had to restart the game because I had made some wrong choices and the save just put me smack dab back into the middle of that wrong decision and so I kept dying. Frustrating.  An interesting premise of a story with graphics that are right up my alley and I’m a sucker for a detective game. Can’t wait to see the finished product!

正好今晚看到橘子班的新作《我和她的世界末日》即将登录steam，心中大有所感，打算借此机会将自己玩过的橘子班的游戏逐一评测一番。  个人见解，如有不慎或者错漏，望各位海涵。  第一次接触橘子班（落叶岛）的作品其实并不是《高恋》，虽然这个国产gal也算是鼎鼎大名。  大约是一年前的时候，我在b站的游戏区看到有主播做了炒饭老师的《恋爱模拟器·告白篇》，后来又追加了约会篇、吵架篇、春节特别篇等。  要我来说的话，这大概是最贴近国情的伪galgame了，或者说是视觉小说……用的基本都是真实的JK小姐姐的照片（好评w），某些对话很有实感，各种选项几乎句句是在反讽（笑），结局往往让人意外。  之后又在朋友的推荐下买了这个短篇集。  玩了第一个减肥游戏的时候，感觉不太像炒饭老师的风格，因为少了那种类似于蔡智恒老师的莫名幽默感。不过，整体来说，虽然女朋友是爱抖露这一点比较违和之外，其余的地方确实体现出了减肥的困难（虽然我靠吃一个月的三明治就轻松地减了下来w），没有毅力和方法是很难成功的。  至于《清明节》系列，不知为何，在我看来似乎有点摸鱼之嫌，像是萌系的聊斋，去除了一些恐怖的成分——鬼在其中不是什么神秘的存在，只是为女主角套上了一个注定会悲剧的身份。实际说来，大致就像日系的纯爱gal，就我而言并没有看到太大的亮点。  不过《鬼不萌》那里的最后选项倒是让我意外，故意选择了不放手，想要看看到底会怎样，居然进了HappyEnd……  玩了很多炒饭老师写剧本的游戏，感觉《清明节》系列不是很有炒饭老师那种毁人三观、报复社会的风格→_→（例如《毁灭地球的光棍》，主角明明有毁灭世界的力量，但是又无法自证，因为一旦使用就将一切归零，之前所做的一切都没有意义了，在游戏中的体现就是GG重来。可怕的是，看似十分关心主角的妹系青梅竹马，其实是躲在幕后的心机girl。主角忍着被杨教授一次次电击都是为了保护这个自己喜欢的女孩，然而最后的真结局却给玩家当头一棒 ╮(╯▽╰)╭炒饭：没想到吧？）  《毁灭地球的光棍》给我的感觉，类似于另一个热衷报复社会的日本独立游戏制作人的作品——《真琴莫比乌斯》，一旦放弃轮回/炸地球，之前努力坚持的一切就没有意义了。因此，只要玩家想看到结局，就不可能继续选择这个选项，在上帝视角看来则近似世界线的收束，也就相当于在有意义的未来中，主人公毁灭地球的能力根本就不存在（迷之哲学）  了解到了炒饭的恶趣味，再玩《清明节》就有一种炒饭不可能会写这种纯爱的感觉→_→。  说真的，《毁灭地球的光棍》的女主角甚至让我联想到了《高恋》的木馨……  玩《高恋》一周目的时候，因为没看攻略，不知道应该学习还是恋爱，所以一模分数与一本线差了两分……  本以为之后会和木馨一起努力学习奔向美好明天（雾），结果突然画风一转，先是被父母贬入尘埃，然后更气的是，本以为是日系天然幼染驯系的女朋友木馨，竟然一看到“我”就话语敷衍，甚至故意躲开（黑人问号），紧接着就是咖啡厅里的被分手（喂！说好的一定要一起考上好的大学呢？就这样两句话把我踹了╮(╯▽╰)╭）  之后想来，估计是“我”沉迷学习好感没有刷够的缘故，而这也正是炒饭报复社会的一点——木馨不是日系galgame里那样、性格完美到近乎虚假的那种女主角，而是和现实里我所认识的许多女生一般——畏缩，不负责任，也不够勇敢（相较起来，罗小涵的性格着实完美到不像真人）  更惨的是，男主心态爆炸以后和女朋友木馨大吵了起来，就像《看不到的恋人》里说的那样——把对方当成垃圾桶一般。之后，木馨说了一句很多白莲花女神常说的话——“太好了，以后我们还是朋友呢(≥/////ω/////≤)”。  这句话真的很虚伪……也很伤人（别问了，我没有故事→_→）  后来的主角，开始变得越来越悲观，先是沉迷泡网吧，最后直接连晚自习也不去了，几乎没有挽救的机会（玩到这里我的心态爆炸了，直接重开一档，没想到之后居然还有卷心菜，黑人问号，炒饭：没想到吧？）  很多玩过高恋的人可能会讨厌木馨，就是因为她不自知的软弱会彻底把主人公——“我”推下深渊这一点。  时隔许久，再玩《迎接春天的魔法师》，得知主人公向木馨表白的前因后果，反而会觉得更加悲哀。  因为高练（主人公的名字多半是在影射“高恋”，也即“高考恋爱”）应该是真的很憧憬木馨的，但是这个女朋友却会因为各种阻力而反手将自己推开（尽管现实的确如此，不像许多gal，有那种愿意为主人公付出一切的女孩，但不得不说，这种在游戏中也要点醒玩家明白现实的操作是挺报复社会。因此，哪怕二周目很轻松就靠护身符打出了好结局，但是木馨在我心里的印象也无法完全洗白——一个会主动找自己去约会、晚自习结束还会偷偷跑去为自己买护身符的女孩，却在来自老师、同学、学校、家长还有高考的压力面前一触即溃……不知是该说心疼还是悲哀）  再谈谈《高恋》的压力、体力值系统，它一度让我觉得主人公过于娇贵，常常因为一些小事就压力猛增，或是因体力偏低就成绩骤降，而后由于一模考试失利彻底崩溃，陷入无法拯救的死循环。  在我看来，这无疑是有些浮夸的，但是通关多次以后，却觉得它浮夸得反而有些现实了，因为想想我自己，有时也会因为一些小事而忿怒、不安，甚至心态崩溃。  也许是因由在《高恋》里投入了许多时间，经历重重阻难打出好结局的那一刻……真的莫名感动，感觉之前的许多剧情所带来的压抑一下子变得明朗起来。  在我看来，橘子班（落叶岛）的很多作品都是在某些方面具有教育意义的佳作，能够让人知晓怎样去规避人生中一些可能经历的BadEnd，从而尽量不留遗憾。  回归正题。  玩到倒数第二个游戏，也就是《看不见的恋人》的时候，我其实有些讶异。  它主要讲的是之前网上流传的“虚拟女友”服务——也就是萌妹子早上电话叫起床、陪聊、安慰等等。  这让我想起了《死亡直播间》，以及《恋爱模拟器》中的许多细节（绿帽侠？雾）也都是根据现实里的一些事象来取材。  而游戏里提到了一个很有意思的概念：情感是否能够量化，又能否等同于一种交易呢？  人对于自己亲近的人，往往会有各种各样的苛求，因为有了期待；而对于一个先前并不相识的陌生人，一旦觉得投缘，却又能无拘无束地向对方倾诉自己的想法。  这不禁让我回想：为什么对于亲密的人都做不到的事，在一个全然陌生甚至没见过面的人身上却能达成呢？  可能就像游戏中小蝎子说的那样，是因为对其不抱有过多的期待。  不抱期待地与对方交往，没有所得，那是意料之内，而若是有意想不到的收获，则会不由自主地欢欣愉悦。  不由得让我想起了自己为人处事的原则：不会对与自己相识的任何人抱有期待，但又会对陌生人心怀好感，因为若无所求，就不会失望，也不会不安。  就像蔡智恒老师在《第一次的亲密接触》里所说的那般：亲密不是亲蜜，因为亲密的“密”是秘密的“密”，互相亲近，彼此却又怀抱着各自的秘密，无法告诉对方，这就是人与人之间的交往。  这部作品的结局虽然不是很完满，但却让我感到很温暖，有种蔡智恒老师的《檞寄生》一般纯粹而又清新的感觉。  最后一个游戏——《最后的十二小时》，总给我一种赶工而成之感，许多细节方面都处理得过于简略了，但是也有一个有趣的地方，那就是对于重要设定的隐瞒。在这点上，让我想起了怪才道尾秀介的猎奇推理——《向日葵不开的夏天》，看到最后，会彻底颠覆最初的观点。  总之，诸多作品都推荐一番，至少在我看来值得一玩。  顺便期待《我和她的世界末日》的重制版w  职业病……像写小说一样吧啦吧啦写了一堆，估计也没人能够看到这里。  最后支持一下炒饭老师，希望橘子班的游戏能够越来越精彩。

As far as killer AAA VR titles go, especially multiplayer ones, this is hands down one of the best so far.  The best of this game comes out when everyone is joking with Star Trek references, making fun of the Captail, and overall having a great time while proceeding with whatever mission objectives that command throws at your team.   While you can just grind through the missons with laser like focus, (I teamed up with a Captain that was exactly this) the game looses a little bit of its charm when the crew isn't talking and just doing what they should be doing, but without any real interatcion, you might as well just play with AI.   To really enjoy Bridge Crew, you can't take it too seriously.   Approach even a repeat mission differently, do something out of order, play around, make mistakes, and make sure everyone is having a good time to make for one of the most memorable Multiplayer VR expereinces yet.   Also of note for Oculus owners currently (As of 5/30/2017) Be sure to get the HelloV app if you would like to multitask with a webbrowser ingame so you can watch your Twitch/YouTube stream chat, queue up some Spotify, watch YouTube/Netflix/Plex while you crew up in space. AugmentedVR is fantastic.

Claws & Feathers: ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~   Claws & feathers is a puzzle game setup like a grid. The aim of the game is to be the good chook by saving all the poor little chicks trapped in cages.  You will have to match at least 3 chickens of the same colour to make them fly off the grid but if you do not succeed coloured eggs will hatch and more birds will appear on the board. Place your chickens strategically to grab menacing cats and fly them off the grid. Every time you remove a cat from the board items will be revealed, such as keys or bombs. Keys will unlock the cages to free your beautiful chicks and see them flying gracefully to their nest. Bombs will explode to remove obstacles such as walls. Calculate your move carefully so you do not overpopulate the board with chickens thereby freezing your next move.     From time to time, you will have several objectives to achieve within a level. This can be tricky; you might need to unchain all chickens, remove walls and if you are lucky you may even have to beat the clock! They are plenty of variations per level, which is exactly what you want for this type of game. Succeed and you will be rewarded with a golden egg!   Claws and Feathers will appeal to all gamers for hours and will definitely keep you well entertained.  Graphics and soundtrack are good and the game runs very well! In a nutshell, it is a lot of fun.  Positive: ~~~~~~~    -	Good puzzle game -	Plenty of variations per level -	Nice graphics and soundtrack    -	Achievements -	Trading cards  Negative: ~~~~~~~~    -	Beat the clock levels are quiet hard and might be frustrating  A good game to have in your library.  8/10  Key provided by developer/publisher for review purposes. 体量不算大的一款影像互动游戏，里面不乏有隐形守护者的影子，甚至掺杂了一些底特律变人的玩法，但是两种模式都没有学到精髓。 没有隐形守护者的多线程结局，并且逻辑上有很多漏洞和槽点，比如一块玉没卖出去直接结局来到一个月后就要饿死了，这我不理解。 某些内容上虽然有让人操作的互动节点，比如第一幕的揭开尸体遮布，但是作为一款悬疑解密的互动影像游戏，难道不是让玩家输密码来的更有成就感吗，比如后面连绳的密码箱，仅仅一个查看就过场动画了，就会觉得交互感觉非常差甚至有点敷衍。 剧情设计上虽有反转，但都以搞笑居多，虽然知道游戏是为了让玩家更容易通关和完成游戏，但最终结局上却只有很少的线索内容给到观众和玩家反馈，才会让人觉得这居然是挖了个坑，甚至觉得这几十块花的不值，有点圈钱的味道。  演员的演技整体来说还是很有沉浸感的，导演应该是按照传统电视剧电影的方式来拍摄的，没有什么互动影像经验，对于剧本杀玩家再来体验会觉得有种我想动脑子，这个地方却不需要我动脑子的感觉，但只是作为电影来看还是具有一定的观赏性，只是我没想到还是个系列剧。 可以看出制作组很努力的想把“互动”两个字在游戏里体现出来，也可以感受到做了很多努力，但是剧情一旦失败就从头来还是会让人很难沉浸到剧情之中，多来几次我就只会想着怎么过这一关，因为每个小章回里的剧情其实并不难猜，稍微会让人有点倦怠。  盲猜一下，如果出续作的话，可能会有以下几个变化： 1.续集可能会有多结局，比如统治了国家，当了皇帝，或者隐居山林，最后被找到斩草除根。 2.解密环节可能会更多，交互积分或者说是交互内容上可能会增加更多影响结局的故事线 3.剧情中关键人物的人物性格会更加饱满，可能好的是坏的，坏的是好的。 4.线索搜集更加具象化，可以360°观察，玩家可以通过更多方式发现隐藏线索。

C&C i Red Alert jsem hrál v době vydání a mám je v původní podobě v The First Decade edici, kde je vlastně vše kromě třetího RA, a neměl jsem se k tomu si je zahrát, přeci jen na dnešních monitorech je to dost kostkovaný, a když jsem se dozvěděl o Remasteru, tak jsem si řekl, že počkám (i přesto jak dopadl Warcraft 3). Nakonec Remaster dorazil na Steam bez nutnosti Originu a za dobrou cenu, takže koupě byla jasná, a já se nestačil divit, co jsem dostal...  Naprosto báječnou hru (DVĚ hry) a návrat do začátků hraní na PC :) Remaster se vážně povedl, podpora vysokého rozlišení, pečlivá práce s designem budov, jednotek, a všech vnitřností, které zařizují chod hry na dnešních OS a doplnění veškerého obsahu, který pro obě hry vyšel. Tohle je prostě špičková práce a dokonce můžete realtime přepínat mezi původní grafikou a obdivovat celou tu práci. A musím říci, že tady ten remaster rozhodně stál za to. Mnoho starých her si dnes člověk nerad zahraje, protože to prostě nevypadá příjemně. Nechce se vám v tom trávit čas. Další špičková práce byla provedena v restauraci muziky do hires kvality a dokonce některé segmenty Frank Klepacki znovu nahrál. Stejně tak neuvěřitelná restaurace videí, včetně záběrů z natáčení. Samozřejmě ne všechny videa šlo spravit do top notch kvality, cca 15 % videí je ve špatné, skoro původní kvalitě, protože původní zdroj nešlo dostatečně restaurovat.
